[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|debit_card|gift_card|loyalty_redemption|3pd_settlement|mobile_wallet|voucher — promote to reference product if additional tender types are needed]
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Tender Type Configuration; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: tendered_amount
attributes.description: The gross amount presented by the guest for this specific tender line. In cash scenarios, this may exceed the order total, resulting in change due. In card scenarios, this equals the charged amount. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for payment-level financial analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Revenue Recognition; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: third_party_delivery_partner
attributes.description: Identifies the 3PD (Third-Party Delivery) aggregator platform responsible for payment settlement when tender_type is 3pd_settlement. Used for partner-level remittance reconciliation and commission tracking.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — 3PD Integration; FTC Franchise Disclosure

attributes.name: third_party_order_reference
attributes.description: The order identifier assigned by the 3PD (Third-Party Delivery) partner platform (e.g., DoorDash order ID, Uber Eats order ID). Used to cross-reference restaurant POS records with delivery partner settlement reports.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — 3PD Order Mapping

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Gratuity amount added by the guest to this payment tender. Tracked separately from the order total for labor distribution, tax reporting, and server tip-out calculations. Applicable in casual and fine-dining service models.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 531 — Reporting Tip Income; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: token
attributes.description: A network-issued or processor-issued token that replaces the actual card PAN (Primary Account Number) for secure storage and recurring payment processing. Enables PCI DSS scope reduction through tokenization.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5 — Tokenization; EMV Payment Tokenization Specification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this payment record was last modified in the data platform, such as when a status transitions from authorized to settled or a refund is processed.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Audit Trail Requirements; PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10

products.name: status_event
products.description: Immutable event log tracking every lifecycle state transition of a guest order from placement through fulfillment or cancellation. States include: received, acknowledged, in_preparation, ready, dispatched, delivered, cancelled, voided. Captures the state, prior state, transition timestamp, triggering actor (POS, KDS, OLO, 3PD webhook), and any exception reason. Enables SOS (Speed of Service) and ticket time analytics.
products.reference: Oracle MICROS KDS Status / Olo Order Webhook Event

attributes.name: status_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each immutable order lifecycle state transition event record in the Silver layer. Primary key of this append-only event log.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (FOH cashier, BOH cook, or manager) who manually triggered this state transition. Null when the transition was system- or device-initiated. Supports labor accountability and SOS coaching.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Employee Master; Oracle MICROS POS — Employee Clock-In

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent guest order for which this status transition event was recorded. Links all lifecycle events back to the originating order.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Order Management Module

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Oracle MICROS POS terminal or kiosk that captured or processed this state transition event. Used for terminal-level performance diagnostics and audit trails.

attributes.name: source_status_event_id
attributes.description: The native event or transaction identifier assigned by the originating source system (e.g., MICROS transaction ID, OLO event UUID, KDS bump ID). Enables exact-match deduplication and cross-system reconciliation during Silver layer ingestion.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; Internal Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant location where the order was placed and fulfilled. Used to segment Speed of Service (SOS) and ticket time analytics by location.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The operational business date to which this event is attributed for financial and operational reporting purposes. May differ from event_date for late-night orders that cross midnight but belong to the prior business day's P&L period.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Business Day Configuration; GAAP/IFRS Reporting Period Standards

attributes.name: cumulative_elapsed_seconds
attributes.description: Total number of seconds elapsed from the initial 'received' event to this event, representing the running ticket time for the order up to this point. Used to measure end-to-end Speed of Service (SOS) at any point in the lifecycle.
attributes.references: NRA Speed of Service (SOS) Standards; Oracle MICROS POS — Ticket Time Reporting

attributes.name: current_state
attributes.description: The order lifecycle state that this event transitions the order INTO. Drives Speed of Service (SOS) analytics, KDS routing, and fulfillment tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|acknowledged|in_preparation|ready|dispatched|delivered|cancelled|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; KDS (Kitchen Display System) Workflow; Olo Digital Ordering Platform

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Silver layer data quality classification for this event record. Values: valid (passed all checks), suspect (failed one or more quality rules), duplicate (identified as a duplicate of another event), late_arriving (received significantly after event_timestamp), corrected (overrides a prior suspect record).
attributes.references: Internal Data Quality Framework; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: The operational daypart segment during which this event occurred (e.g., breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night). Used to segment Speed of Service (SOS) and throughput analytics by time-of-day business period.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Daypart Configuration; NRA Daypart Standards

attributes.name: delivery_zone
attributes.description: Geographic delivery zone or radius tier assigned to this order for third-party delivery (3PD) or direct delivery fulfillment. Used for delivery time SOS benchmarking and zone-level fulfillment analytics.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — Delivery Zone Configuration

attributes.name: drive_thru_lane
attributes.description: Identifies the specific drive-thru (DT) lane associated with this order event for multi-lane drive-thru configurations. Null or 'none' for non-drive-thru channels. Enables per-lane SOS and throughput analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Drive-Thru Configuration; NRA Drive-Thru Standards

attributes.name: elapsed_seconds_in_prior_state
attributes.description: Number of seconds the order spent in the prior_state before transitioning to the current_state. Computed at ingestion time from consecutive event timestamps. Core input for Speed of Service (SOS) and ticket time analytics.
attributes.references: NRA Speed of Service (SOS) Standards; Oracle MICROS POS — Ticket Time Reporting

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) on which this event occurred, derived from event_timestamp. Stored as a discrete DATE column to support efficient date-based partitioning, daily SOS reporting, and Same-Store Sales (SSS) period alignment.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; GAAP/IFRS Reporting Period Standards

attributes.name: event_sequence
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing integer representing the ordinal position of this event within the full lifecycle of a single order. Enables reconstruction of the complete state machine path (e.g., 1=received, 2=acknowledged, 3=in_preparation).
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Order Event Stream

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the order transitioned into the current state. The principal real-world event time used for Speed of Service (SOS) and ticket time calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; ISO 8601

attributes.name: exception_reason_code
attributes.description: Structured code indicating why an exceptional transition occurred (e.g., ITEM_OUT_OF_STOCK, GUEST_CANCEL, PAYMENT_FAILED, EQUIPMENT_DOWN, DUPLICATE_ORDER). Null for normal lifecycle transitions. Drives exception reporting and root-cause analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full code list]
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Exception Codes; Zenput Operational Compliance

attributes.name: exception_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the exception or anomaly that caused this state transition, as entered by staff or returned by the triggering system. Supplements the structured exception_reason_code for operational context.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Exception Notes; Zenput Operational Compliance

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal reporting period (e.g., '2024-P04-W02') to which this event belongs, aligned to the company's internal fiscal calendar. Enables period-over-period SOS and throughput comparisons in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Fiscal Calendar; GAAP/IFRS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: fulfillment_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order was placed for immediate fulfillment, scheduled for a future time (advance order), or ASAP (as-soon-as-possible with a requested window). Affects SOS target calculation and kitchen scheduling.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — Order Scheduling; Oracle MICROS POS

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this event record was first written into the Silver layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (real-world event time). Used for data latency monitoring, pipeline SLA tracking, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard — Silver Layer Audit; Databricks Lakehouse Best Practices

attributes.name: is_cancellation_event
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this event represents an order cancellation (current_state = 'cancelled'). Enables rapid filtering for cancellation rate analytics, refund processing triggers, and guest recovery workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform — Cancellation Policy

attributes.name: is_sos_breach
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the cumulative elapsed time at this event exceeded the configured SOS target for the channel and daypart. True = SOS breach detected. Drives SOS compliance dashboards and operational alerts.

attributes.name: is_terminal_state
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the current_state is a terminal (end-of-lifecycle) state for the order (i.e., delivered, cancelled, or voided). Simplifies filtering for completed order analytics without requiring state enumeration logic.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Order Lifecycle Definition

attributes.name: is_void_event
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this event represents an order void (current_state = 'voided'). Voids differ from cancellations in that they are typically manager-initiated post-tender corrections. Supports POS audit and loss prevention reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Void Management; PCI DSS — Transaction Integrity

attributes.name: kds_station_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the KDS (Kitchen Display System) station that acknowledged or bumped this order event. Populated only when the triggering actor is KDS. Enables BOH (Back of House) station-level ticket time analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — KDS Integration; KDS (Kitchen Display System) Workflow

attributes.name: manager_override
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this state transition required a manager authorization override (e.g., void, post-close cancellation, or exception state). Supports loss prevention, audit compliance, and operational accountability reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Manager Override Log; OSHA SOP Compliance

attributes.name: olo_order_reference
attributes.description: External order reference number assigned by the Olo Digital Ordering Platform for online and mobile orders. Populated only for OLO-originated events. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and the OLO platform.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — Order API

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order by business purpose. Values: standard (regular guest order), lto (Limited Time Offer promotional order), catering, group, loyalty_redemption, comp (complimentary). Enables type-specific SOS benchmarking and PMIX analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS — Order Type Configuration; NRA Order Classification

attributes.name: partition_date
attributes.description: The date value used as the physical partition key for this table in the Databricks Lakehouse Delta Lake storage layer. Typically aligned to business_date to optimize time-range query performance for SOS and throughput analytics.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Delta Lake Partitioning Best Practices; Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: prior_state
attributes.description: The order lifecycle state immediately before this transition event. Null for the first event (initial placement). Enables detection of invalid state transitions and rollback analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|acknowledged|in_preparation|ready|dispatched|delivered|cancelled|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; KDS (Kitchen Display System) Workflow

attributes.name: promise_time_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time communicated to the guest as the expected ready or delivery time at the moment of order placement. Used to measure promise-time accuracy and guest satisfaction (CSAT) correlation.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — Promise Time API; NRA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this event record was last modified in the Silver layer (e.g., due to late-arriving corrections or enrichment). For a truly immutable event log this should rarely change; tracked for data quality auditing.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard — Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: scheduled_fulfillment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the guest requested or the system scheduled for order fulfillment. Populated only for scheduled/advance orders. Used to calculate on-time fulfillment rate and schedule adherence.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — Order Scheduling

attributes.name: service_channel
attributes.description: The order fulfillment channel through which the guest placed the order. Drives channel-specific SOS benchmarks and throughput analytics. Values: dine_in, drive_thru (DT), online (OLO), third_party_delivery (3PD), catering, kiosk, curbside. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dine_in|drive_thru|online|third_party_delivery|catering|kiosk|curbside — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; NRA Channel Classification

attributes.name: sos_target_seconds
attributes.description: The configured Speed of Service (SOS) target in seconds for this service channel and daypart combination at the time of the event. Enables real-time and historical SOS compliance measurement against operational benchmarks.
attributes.references: NRA Speed of Service (SOS) Standards; Oracle MICROS POS — SOS Configuration

attributes.name: third_party_delivery_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party delivery (3PD) aggregator that submitted the webhook triggering this event (e.g., doordash, uber_eats, grubhub). Null or 'none' for non-3PD channels. Enables 3PD-specific SOS and fulfillment analytics.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — 3PD Integration; FTC Advertising Regulations

attributes.name: third_party_event_reference
attributes.description: External event or webhook identifier provided by the third-party delivery (3PD) provider for this specific state transition. Used for cross-system reconciliation and dispute resolution with 3PD partners.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform — 3PD Webhook Specification

attributes.name: triggering_actor
attributes.description: The system or human actor that initiated this state transition. Values include POS (Oracle MICROS Point of Sale), KDS (Kitchen Display System), OLO (Online Ordering platform), 3PD (Third-Party Delivery webhook), CATERING, STAFF (manual override), SYSTEM (automated rule), or GUEST (self-service cancellation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: POS|KDS|OLO|3PD|CATERING|STAFF|SYSTEM|GUEST — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; 3PD Integration Specification

products.name: channel
products.description: Reference master defining all service channels through which guest orders are placed: POS (dine-in, counter), drive-thru (DT), online ordering (OLO), third-party delivery (3PD — DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub), catering, kiosk, and mobile app. Captures channel code, channel category, integration platform, fulfillment mode (dine-in, takeout, delivery, curbside), and active status. Serves as the FK target for guest_order channel attribution, channel-mix reporting, and ACV benchmarking.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order channel. Primary key for the order_channel reference master.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: add column brand_id (BIGINT) with FK to restaurant.brand.brand_id - order channels should be scoped to brands since different brands may support different channels

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when this order channel was first activated and made available for order placement across the restaurant network.

attributes.name: average_ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: Benchmark average ticket time (order placement to fulfillment) in seconds for this channel, used for Speed of Service (SOS) performance tracking. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: channel_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the channel by service model: dine_in (FOH counter, table service), takeout (DT, counter pickup), delivery (3PD, own delivery), catering (bulk orders), hybrid (multi-mode channels like kiosk).

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Ownership classification of the channel: owned (company-operated channels like POS, DT, proprietary OLO), third_party (external platforms like 3PD aggregators), hybrid (co-branded or white-label solutions).

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the order channel (e.g., POS, DT, OLO, 3PD, KIOSK, MOBILE, CATERING). Used as the business identifier for integration and reporting.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Commission or transaction fee percentage charged by the channel provider (applicable to 3PD channels). Null for owned channels. Used for COGS and P&L analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order channel record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when this order channel was deactivated or retired. Null if the channel is still active.

attributes.name: default_daypart
attributes.description: Default daypart (e.g., breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night) typically associated with this channel. Null if the channel operates across all dayparts equally.

attributes.name: channel_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the order channel, including its purpose, typical use cases, and any special operational considerations.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying this channel in reporting dashboards and user interfaces. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: fulfillment_mode
attributes.description: Primary method by which orders placed through this channel are fulfilled: dine_in (guest consumes on-premise), takeout (guest picks up), delivery (delivered to guest location), curbside (pickup at designated area), catering (scheduled bulk delivery).

attributes.name: integration_platform
attributes.description: Name of the technology platform or system that powers this channel (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Olo, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, proprietary mobile app). Null for native POS channels.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this channel is currently active and available for order placement. False indicates the channel has been retired or temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: is_digital
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a digital channel (true for OLO, mobile app, kiosk, 3PD; false for traditional POS, DT counter service).

attributes.name: kds_routing_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether orders from this channel are routed to the Kitchen Display System (KDS) for BOH preparation tracking. True for most channels; may be false for catering orders prepared off-site.

attributes.name: channel_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the order channel (e.g., Point of Sale, Drive-Thru, Online Ordering, Third-Party Delivery, Kiosk, Mobile App, Catering).

attributes.name: requires_restaurant_assignment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether orders from this channel must be assigned to a specific restaurant location at order time (true for delivery, catering; false for walk-in POS).

attributes.name: supports_guest_data_capture
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this channel captures guest identification and contact information (true for OLO, mobile, 3PD; false for anonymous POS transactions).

attributes.name: supports_loyalty_integration
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this channel supports integration with the customer loyalty program for points accrual and redemption.
attributes.references: CRM and Loyalty Program Integration Standards

attributes.name: supports_payment_at_order
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether payment is collected at the time of order placement (true for OLO, 3PD, mobile; false for traditional counter service where payment occurs at pickup).

attributes.name: supports_scheduled_orders
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this channel allows customers to schedule orders for future fulfillment (true for catering, some OLO platforms; false for immediate-service channels like DT).

attributes.name: target_sos_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Speed of Service (SOS) in Seconds
attributes.description: Target Speed of Service (SOS) threshold in seconds for this channel, representing the operational goal for order fulfillment time. Used for performance benchmarking and SOP compliance.

tag_set.value: Target Speed of Service (SOS) in Seconds

attributes.name: third_party_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party delivery service provider if this channel is a 3PD channel (e.g., DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Postmates). Null for non-3PD channels.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order channel record was last modified.

products.name: daypart
products.description: Reference entity defining the standard trading periods used to segment restaurant operations and sales: breakfast, morning snack, lunch, afternoon, dinner, late night. Captures daypart name, start time, end time, daypart category, and whether it is a primary or secondary daypart. Foundational dimension for PMIX analysis, labor scheduling, and ATC/ACV benchmarking by time-of-day.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order_daypart data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.guest_order. Business justification: order_daypart represents the assignment of a daypart to an order; the child table should hold the FK to the parent order.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: add column restaurant_unit_id (BIGINT) with FK to restaurant.unit.unit_id - daypart references a guest_order but should also link to the unit for scheduling context

products.name: kds_ticket
products.description: Represents a kitchen display system (KDS) production ticket generated from a guest order, routed to a specific BOH station (grill, fryer, assembly, expo). Captures ticket creation time, station assignment, bump time, re-fire events, ticket time (seconds), SOS target compliance flag, and fulfillment handoff timestamp. Core operational record for kitchen throughput, ticket time compliance, BOH performance management, and FOH handoff coordination.

attributes.name: kds_ticket_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the KDS ticket. Primary key for the kds_ticket product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the BOH employee who was assigned to or completed this ticket. Used for individual performance tracking and labor productivity analysis.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent guest order that generated this KDS ticket. Links the ticket to the originating transaction captured at the POS.

attributes.name: kitchen_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific BOH kitchen station (grill, fryer, assembly, expo, beverage) to which this ticket was routed. Critical for station-level performance tracking.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce shift during which this ticket was processed. Enables shift-level throughput and labor efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant location where this KDS ticket was generated. Enables location-level throughput and SOS analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this record was first inserted into the data platform. Used for data lineage and ETL tracking.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time-of-day segment when the ticket was created. Used for daypart-specific throughput analysis and labor planning. Common values: breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night, snack.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of menu items included on this KDS ticket. Used to analyze ticket complexity and its impact on preparation time.

attributes.name: modifier_count
attributes.description: Total number of modifiers (customizations, substitutions, add-ons) applied to items on this ticket. Higher modifier counts typically increase ticket time.

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: Service channel through which the originating order was placed. Values include dine_in (FOH table service), drive_thru (DT), online (OLO direct), third_party_delivery (3PD platforms), catering, kiosk.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the ticket. Rush and VIP orders receive expedited handling. Catering orders may have extended preparation windows.

attributes.name: re_fire_count
attributes.description: Number of times this ticket was re-fired. Multiple re-fires indicate recurring quality or accuracy issues. Zero indicates no remakes were required.

attributes.name: re_fire_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this ticket was re-fired (sent back to the kitchen for remake) due to quality issues, order errors, or customer complaints. True indicates a remake event occurred.

attributes.name: re_fire_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why the ticket was re-fired. Common reasons include incorrect preparation, quality defect, missing items, customer request, order entry error.

attributes.name: sos_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the ticket was completed within the SOS target time. True if ticket_time_seconds <= sos_target_seconds, False otherwise. Critical for operational compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sos_target_seconds
attributes.description: Target ticket time in seconds defined by restaurant operations standards for this station and order channel. Used to determine SOS compliance.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field containing customer special requests, preparation notes, or allergy warnings that BOH staff must follow when preparing this ticket.

attributes.name: ticket_bumped_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ticket was bumped (cleared) from the KDS screen by BOH staff, indicating the order was sent to the customer or next station.

attributes.name: ticket_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all items on the ticket were finished and ready for service or pickup. Used to calculate total ticket time.

attributes.name: ticket_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the KDS ticket was generated and routed to the station. Start point for ticket time calculation and SOS measurement.

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: Human-readable ticket number displayed on the KDS screen and printed on kitchen receipts. Used by BOH staff to identify and track production items.

attributes.name: ticket_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order number of this ticket within the parent order. Multi-station orders generate multiple tickets; this field tracks the sequence.

attributes.name: ticket_started_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when BOH staff began actively preparing the items on this ticket. Marks transition from new to in_progress status.

attributes.name: ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KDS ticket. Tracks progression from new (just routed) through in_progress (being prepared), completed (finished), bumped (cleared from screen), voided (cancelled), or re_fired (sent back for remake).

attributes.name: ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from ticket creation to ticket completion. Core KPI for kitchen throughput and speed of service (SOS) performance measurement.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: void_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this ticket was voided (cancelled) before completion. True indicates the ticket was cancelled and items were not prepared.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why the ticket was voided. Common reasons include customer cancellation, order entry error, system error, duplicate ticket.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Void Reason Codes

products.name: drive_thru_event
products.description: Captures timestamped sensor and timer events for each vehicle progressing through the drive-thru (DT) lane: arrival at menu board, order placed, pull-forward, window arrival, payment complete, food handoff, departure. Enables Speed of Service (SOS) measurement at each DT stage, throughput analysis, and benchmarking against brand SOS targets. Sourced from DT timer systems integrated with Oracle MICROS POS.
products.reference: Drive-Thru Timer System / MICROS DT Integration

attributes.name: drive_thru_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each drive-thru event record. Primary key for the drive_thru_event product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who served the customer at the time of the event (e.g., order taker, cashier, or expediter).

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the order associated with this drive-thru event, linking to the order captured in Oracle MICROS POS.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Oracle MICROS POS terminal that processed the order associated with this drive-thru event.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the drive-thru event occurred.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the drive-thru event occurred.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The operational business date for the drive-thru event, which may differ from the calendar date for late-night operations (e.g., 2 AM transaction may belong to the previous business day).

attributes.name: cumulative_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds from the vehicles initial menu board arrival to the current event. Represents the running total ticket time for the vehicle.
attributes.references: NRA ServSafe Speed of Service Standards

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time-of-day segment when the drive-thru event occurred: breakfast, lunch, afternoon, dinner, or late_night. Used for daypart-specific Speed of Service (SOS) benchmarking and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: elapsed_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time elapsed in seconds from the previous event in the drive-thru sequence for this vehicle. Used to calculate stage-specific Speed of Service (SOS) metrics such as menu board time, window time, and total ticket time.
attributes.references: NRA ServSafe Speed of Service Standards

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the drive-thru event occurred, captured by drive-thru timer sensors integrated with Oracle MICROS POS. Used for Speed of Service (SOS) calculation.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of drive-thru event being recorded: menu_board_arrival (vehicle arrives at menu board), order_placed (order confirmed), pull_forward (vehicle directed to wait), window_arrival (vehicle reaches service window), payment_complete (payment transaction finalized), food_handoff (order delivered to customer), departure (vehicle exits drive-thru lane). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: menu_board_arrival|order_placed|pull_forward|window_arrival|payment_complete|food_handoff|departure — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drive-thru event represents an exception or anomaly (e.g., sensor malfunction, manual override, system error). True if exception occurred, False for normal operation.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the exception if exception_flag is True (e.g., sensor malfunction, customer service recovery, order modification, system timeout).

attributes.name: franchise_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the restaurant location is franchise-owned (True) or company-owned (False). Used for comparative Speed of Service (SOS) analysis between franchise and company-owned locations.

attributes.name: kds_ticket_number
attributes.description: Ticket number assigned by the Kitchen Display System (KDS) for the order associated with this drive-thru event, used to correlate drive-thru timing with kitchen preparation timing.

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific drive-thru lane where the event occurred (e.g., 1 for single-lane, 1 or 2 for dual-lane configurations).

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the order was originally placed: drive_thru (ordered at menu board), mobile_order_ahead (pre-ordered via mobile app for drive-thru pickup), or third_party_delivery (3PD order picked up via drive-thru).

attributes.name: order_item_count
attributes.description: Number of individual items in the order associated with this drive-thru event. Used to analyze the relationship between order complexity and Speed of Service (SOS).

attributes.name: order_total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the order associated with this drive-thru event, used for Average Check Value (ACV) calculation and revenue analysis by Speed of Service (SOS) performance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method of payment used for the order associated with this drive-thru event: cash, credit_card, debit_card, mobile_payment, or gift_card. Used to analyze the impact of payment method on Speed of Service (SOS).

attributes.name: pull_forward_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was asked to pull forward to a waiting area during this drive-thru sequence. True if pull-forward occurred, False otherwise. Pull-forwards impact Speed of Service (SOS) metrics and throughput.

attributes.name: queue_length
attributes.description: Number of vehicles in the drive-thru lane at the time of this event, used to analyze the relationship between queue depth and Speed of Service (SOS) performance.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drive-thru event record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drive-thru event record was last updated in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: sensor_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical sensor or timer device that captured this event (e.g., menu board sensor, window sensor, exit sensor).

attributes.name: sos_target_seconds
attributes.description: Brand-defined target time in seconds for this specific drive-thru event type or stage (e.g., 25 seconds for menu board to order placed, 180 seconds for total ticket time). Used for performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: NRA ServSafe Speed of Service Standards

attributes.name: sos_variance_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between the actual elapsed time and the SOS target for this event. Positive values indicate slower-than-target service; negative values indicate faster-than-target service.
attributes.references: NRA ServSafe Speed of Service Standards

attributes.name: vehicle_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to each vehicle entering the drive-thru lane during the business day, used for tracking vehicle progression and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the time of the drive-thru event, captured to analyze the impact of weather on Speed of Service (SOS) and throughput. Values include clear, rain, snow, fog, wind, extreme_heat, extreme_cold. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|snow|fog|wind|extreme_heat|extreme_cold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: delivery_order
products.description: Manages the delivery fulfillment record for orders dispatched via third-party delivery (3PD) platforms (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) or first-party delivery. Captures 3PD platform reference ID, courier assignment, estimated and actual delivery times, delivery distance, delivery fee, platform commission rate, delivery status, and any delivery exception (late, missing item, cancelled). Bridges the Olo digital ordering platform data with internal order records.

attributes.name: actual_prep_time_minutes

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_feedback

attributes.name: customer_rating

attributes.name: delivery_address_line1

attributes.name: delivery_address_line2

attributes.name: delivery_city

attributes.name: delivery_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the delivery destination (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: delivery_distance_km
attributes.description: Calculated distance in kilometers from the restaurant to the delivery destination. Used for delivery fee calculation and logistics analysis.

attributes.name: delivery_exception_type

attributes.name: delivery_fee_amount

attributes.name: delivery_instructions

attributes.name: delivery_latitude

attributes.name: delivery_longitude

attributes.name: delivery_postal_code

attributes.name: delivery_state_province

attributes.name: delivery_status

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_time_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes for the courier to deliver the order from pickup to guest, as provided by the delivery platform routing algorithm.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_timestamp

attributes.name: estimated_prep_time_minutes

attributes.name: exception_notes

attributes.name: is_contactless_delivery

attributes.name: order_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the delivery order was placed by the guest via the online ordering (OLO) or third-party delivery (3PD) platform.

attributes.name: picked_up_timestamp

attributes.name: platform_commission_amount

attributes.name: platform_commission_rate

attributes.name: platform_order_reference

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_url
attributes.description: URL to the proof of delivery image or document (e.g., photo of order at doorstep). Used for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: ready_for_pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was marked as ready for courier pickup in the Kitchen Display System (KDS) or Point of Sale (POS).

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Tip amount provided by the guest to the courier. May be pre-tip or post-delivery adjustment.

attributes.name: total_ticket_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from order placement to actual delivery. Key Speed of Service (SOS) metric for delivery orders.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery order record was last modified.

products.name: discount
products.description: Records all discounts, promotions, coupons, and comp adjustments applied to a guest order or individual order items. Captures discount type (coupon, loyalty redemption, employee meal, manager comp, promotional LTO, bundle/combo deal), discount amount or percentage, promotion reference, authorization employee, and pre-approved vs. exception-based flag. Supports COGS% impact analysis, promotional ROI tracking, and combo savings attribution.

products.name: sos_target
products.description: Reference entity defining brand-mandated Speed of Service (SOS) targets segmented by service channel, daypart, and restaurant format (QSR, casual, fine-dining). Captures daypart definitions (name, start time, end time, category — breakfast, lunch, dinner, late night), target ticket time in seconds, target total order time, channel applicability, effective date range, and whether the target is a brand standard or local operational goal. Serves as the authoritative daypart and SOS benchmark reference for KDS ticket compliance evaluation, drive-thru SOS benchmarking, PMIX time-of-day analysis, ATC/ACV benchmarking, and labor scheduling alignment.
products.reference: Brand SOS Standard / NRA Speed of Service Benchmark

attributes.name: sos_target_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Speed of Service target record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand (QSR, casual, fine-dining) for which this SOS target is defined.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant location to which this SOS target applies. May be null if the target is a brand-wide standard.

attributes.name: superseded_by_target_sos_target_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SOS target that supersedes this target. Null if this is the current active target.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant location to which this SOS target applies. May be null if the target is a brand-wide standard.

attributes.name: applies_to_order_type
attributes.description: The order type to which this SOS target applies: dine_in, takeout, delivery, or all order types.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the person who approved this SOS target for operational use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SOS target was approved for operational use.

attributes.name: compliance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of orders that must meet this SOS target for the restaurant to be considered compliant (e.g., 85.00 means 85% of orders must meet the target).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SOS target record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: The daypart (time segment of the day) to which this SOS target applies: breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night, or all_day.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SOS target expires or is superseded by a new target. Null indicates an open-ended target.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this SOS target becomes effective and should be used for performance evaluation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SOS target is currently active and should be used for performance measurement and KDS compliance evaluation.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for SOS target times: seconds or minutes. Typically seconds for QSR and fast-casual, minutes for fine-dining.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the person who last modified this SOS target record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SOS target record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this SOS target.

attributes.name: peak_hours_only
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SOS target applies only during peak hours (true) or throughout the entire daypart (false).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level of this SOS target for operational compliance and performance evaluation: critical, high, medium, or low.

attributes.name: restaurant_format
attributes.description: The restaurant format type to which this SOS target applies: QSR (Quick-Service Restaurant), casual, fine_dining, fast_casual, or food_court.

attributes.name: service_channel
attributes.description: The service channel to which this SOS target applies: DT (Drive-Thru), counter (Front of House counter service), OLO (Online Ordering), 3PD (Third-Party Delivery), catering, or kiosk.

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the SOS target, used for external reference and reporting (e.g., DT_LUNCH_QSR, COUNTER_DINNER_CASUAL).

attributes.name: target_handoff_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target time in seconds from order ready (on KDS) to order handoff to guest or delivery driver.

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the SOS target (e.g., Drive-Thru Lunch Target, Counter Service Dinner Target).

attributes.name: target_queue_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target time in seconds a guest should wait in queue before placing an order, applicable to counter and drive-thru channels.

attributes.name: target_ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target time in seconds from order placement to order ready on the Kitchen Display System (KDS), representing the kitchen preparation speed target.

attributes.name: target_total_order_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target total time in seconds from order placement to order fulfillment (handed to guest or delivered), representing the complete Speed of Service (SOS) target.

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SOS target: brand_standard (corporate-mandated), local_goal (restaurant-specific operational goal), franchise_goal (franchisee-defined target), or regulatory (mandated by health or safety regulations).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of this SOS target, incremented each time the target is revised or updated.

attributes.name: warning_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The percentage threshold below which a warning alert is triggered for operational management (e.g., 80.00 triggers a warning if compliance falls below 80%).

attributes.name: weather_adjusted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SOS target should be adjusted based on adverse weather conditions that impact throughput.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the person who created this SOS target record.

products.name: tax
products.description: Records tax line details applied to a guest order, supporting multi-jurisdiction tax compliance. Captures tax authority (federal, state, county, city), tax type (sales tax, VAT, beverage tax, bag fee), tax rate, taxable amount, tax amount, and whether the tax was included in the menu price or added at checkout. Supports financial reconciliation and regulatory tax reporting across all restaurant locations.
products.reference: Oracle MICROS Tax Detail / GAAP Tax Reporting

attributes.name: tax_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax line record applied to a guest order. Primary key for the order_tax data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Ensures tax liabilities from each order are posted to the correct tax GL account for compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent guest order to which this tax line belongs. Establishes the header-to-line relationship between guest_order and order_tax.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the order was placed. Used to resolve the applicable tax jurisdiction and for location-level financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the order was placed. Used to resolve the applicable tax jurisdiction and for location-level financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjusted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when a post-transaction tax adjustment was applied to this line. Populated only when tax_status = 'adjusted'. Supports audit trail for tax corrections.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Adjustment; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for a post-transaction tax adjustment when tax_status = 'adjusted' (e.g., rate_correction, jurisdiction_change, exemption_applied, refund, audit_correction, other). Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IRS Audit Requirements; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The computed tax amount for this tax line in the transaction currency (taxable_amount × tax_rate, or as overridden by the tax engine). Core field for financial reconciliation, P&L reporting, and tax remittance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; IRS Publication 334; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line was computed and applied to the order by the tax engine or POS system. Represents the principal business event time for this tax line record.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Transaction Log; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: authority_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the tax authority or jurisdiction as defined by the tax engine or ERP (SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition). Used for automated tax remittance and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration; Vertex Tax Engine

attributes.name: authority_level
attributes.description: The governmental jurisdiction level that imposes this tax line. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance across all restaurant locations. Values: federal, state, county, city, district, special.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; State Revenue Codes; Local Tax Ordinances

attributes.name: authority_name
attributes.description: The full name of the tax authority or jurisdiction imposing this tax (e.g., 'California State Board of Equalization', 'Cook County Revenue Department', 'City of Chicago'). Used for regulatory reporting and remittance.
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Registries; IRS

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The internal or POS-assigned tax code identifying the specific tax rule applied (e.g., 'TX_CA_SALES', 'TX_CHI_BEV'). Maps to the tax condition record in SAP S/4HANA and Oracle MICROS POS tax configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition Records; Oracle MICROS POS Tax Configuration

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the restaurant location for this tax line. Used for internal cost allocation, P&L reporting by location, and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Cost Center Accounting; GAAP/IFRS Management Reporting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Required for international operations, VAT compliance, and cross-border tax reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IFRS IAS 12; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this tax line (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency operations and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: The meal period or daypart during which the order was placed (breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night, snack). Used for daypart-level tax and revenue analysis in foodservice operations.
attributes.references: NRA Daypart Reporting Standards; Oracle MICROS POS Daypart Configuration

attributes.name: engine_source
attributes.description: Identifies the system or engine that calculated and applied this tax line (e.g., pos = Oracle MICROS POS built-in tax, vertex = Vertex O Series, avalara = Avalara AvaTax, sap_tax = SAP S/4HANA tax engine, manual = manually entered). Used for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Tax Configuration; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; Vertex O Series

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the tax exemption certificate presented by the guest or organization. Required for audit documentation when is_exempt is True. Null when no exemption applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 557; State Revenue Authority Exemption Certificate Requirements

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for a tax exemption when is_exempt is True (e.g., government, non_profit, resale, diplomatic, employee_meal, other). Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance. Null when is_exempt is False.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption Guidelines; State Revenue Codes; FTC Franchise Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: is_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax line was flagged as exempt (True) due to a guest exemption certificate, government order, or qualifying non-profit status. When True, tax_amount should be zero and exemption_reason should be populated.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption Guidelines; State Revenue Codes; USDA Exemption Rules

attributes.name: is_refunded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax amount on this line has been refunded to the guest (True) as part of an order refund or cancellation. Used for refund reconciliation and tax reversal tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Refund Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Reversal; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: is_tax_inclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax was already included in the menu price (True) or added at checkout on top of the menu price (False). Critical for VAT/GST jurisdictions and for accurate revenue recognition and tax remittance calculations.

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential number ordering multiple tax lines within the same order (e.g., 1 = state sales tax, 2 = county tax, 3 = city beverage tax). Ensures deterministic ordering for receipt display and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Tax Line Sequencing; NRA Receipt Standards

attributes.name: tax_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax as displayed on the guest receipt or financial report (e.g., 'Illinois Sales Tax', 'Chicago Beverage Tax', 'CA Bag Fee'). Required for receipt compliance and guest transparency.
attributes.references: NRA Receipt Compliance Guidelines; State Consumer Protection Laws

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: The service channel through which the order was placed (pos = in-store Point of Sale, drive_thru = Drive-Thru (DT), olo = Online Ordering (OLO), third_party_delivery = Third-Party Delivery (3PD), kiosk = self-service kiosk, catering). Used for channel-level tax analysis and compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; NRA Channel Reporting Standards

attributes.name: original_tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount as originally computed at the time of order placement, before any post-transaction adjustments. Populated when tax_status = 'adjusted' to preserve the audit trail of the original calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; IRS Audit Requirements

attributes.name: period_date
attributes.description: The business date (yyyy-MM-dd) to which this tax line is attributed for tax remittance and financial period reporting. May differ from the transaction timestamp for end-of-day batch processing or period adjustments.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; IRS Tax Period Rules

attributes.name: pos_tax_line_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Tax Line Reference
attributes.description: The native tax line identifier or sequence number assigned by Oracle MICROS POS for this tax entry. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the POS transaction log and the lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Tax Transaction Log

tag_set.value: Point of Sale (POS) Tax Line Reference

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%). Sourced from the tax engine or POS tax configuration at the time of the transaction. Used for tax amount validation and audit.
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Rate Tables; SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition Records

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount refunded to the guest when is_refunded is True. May be a partial refund (less than tax_amount) for partial order refunds. Used for financial reconciliation and tax reversal reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Refund Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: remittance_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (e.g., '2024-Q1', '2024-03') in which this tax amount is scheduled for remittance to the tax authority. Used for tax filing calendar management and period-end close.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Filing Calendar; State Revenue Authority Filing Schedules; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax amount has been remitted to the applicable tax authority (pending = not yet remitted, remitted = successfully paid to authority, not_applicable = exempt or zero-rate, failed = remittance attempt failed). Supports tax compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Remittance Requirements; State Revenue Authority Filing Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: sap_tax_document_ref
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA FI-TX tax document number associated with this tax line for GL posting and tax remittance. Enables end-to-end traceability from POS transaction to ERP financial posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Document; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent provincial code) of the tax jurisdiction where the restaurant is located (e.g., 'IL', 'CA', 'TX'). Used for state-level tax rate lookup, remittance routing, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI INCITS 38; IRS State Tax Authority Codes; State Revenue Departments

attributes.name: tax_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this tax line record. 'applied' = tax successfully computed and applied; 'voided' = tax line cancelled due to order void; 'adjusted' = tax amount corrected post-transaction; 'pending' = awaiting tax engine resolution; 'reversed' = tax reversed for refund.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Document Status; Oracle MICROS POS Void Processing

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax applied to this line (e.g., sales_tax, vat, beverage_tax, bag_fee, excise_tax, service_tax). Supports differentiated tax reporting and compliance across jurisdictions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_tax|vat|beverage_tax|bag_fee|excise_tax|service_tax|surcharge|environmental_fee — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Regulations; State Revenue Codes; IRS Publication 334

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the order subtotal that is subject to this specific tax line, expressed in the transaction currency. Excludes non-taxable items, exempt amounts, and tax-inclusive components. Used for tax calculation validation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IRS Publication 334; State Revenue Codes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental loads, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line was voided, if applicable. Populated only when tax_status = 'voided'. Used for void audit trail and financial reversal processing.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Void Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Reversal

products.name: order_ingredient_usage
products.description: Association between order_item and stock_item that records the amount of each inventory item consumed by a specific line item, including cost and waste information. Each record links one order_item to one stock_item with attributes that exist only in the context of this consumption.. Existence Justification: Each order line (order_item) consumes one or more inventory stock items (ingredients) and each stock item can be consumed by many order lines. The restaurant tracks the quantity used, unit cost, waste flag and waste reason for every such consumption to support costing, waste analysis and traceability. This relationship is actively created and maintained by the kitchen and back‑office systems.

attributes.description: Reason for waste (e.g., spoilage, over‑prep)

products.description: Master record for every supplier and vendor in the foodservice supply chain, including food and non-food suppliers, distributors, co-manufacturers, and their key contacts. Captures supplier identity, classification (broadline, specialty, local), approval status, diversity certification, payment terms, lead times, regulatory compliance status (FDA, USDA, HACCP), and primary/secondary contact information. SSOT for supplier identity and contact details across supply chain operations. Sourced from Coupa Procurement supplier master and SAP S/4HANA vendor master (MM).

products.name: ingredient

Captures SKU code, ingredient name, commodity category, unit of measure, allergen flags (Big 9), USDA grade, country of origin, shelf life days, storage temperature requirements (ambient/refrigerated/frozen), and HACCP critical control classification. Serves as the supply-side item master linking to menu domain BOM for recipe costing. SSOT for ingredient identity across supply, inventory, and menu domains. Sourced from SAP MM material master and MarketMan Inventory Management.

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Transactional record of inbound goods received at a distribution center or restaurant, including both header-level receipt information and line-level detail per SKU. Header captures receipt date/time, receiving location, PO reference, receiving condition, and inspector ID. Lines capture specific ingredient/SKU received, quantity accepted/rejected, lot number, expiration date, temperature at receipt (cold chain compliance), storage location assigned, and variance from PO quantity. Critical for three-way match (PO-receipt-invoice), HACCP traceability, and ingredient-level lot tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MIGO) and MarketMan receiving module.

products.name: supplier_performance
products.description: Periodic scorecard record evaluating supplier performance against foodservice supply chain KPIs: on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate, case fill rate, order accuracy, quality rejection rate, invoice accuracy, food safety audit score, and cold chain compliance. attributes.name: stock_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred supplier for this stock item. Links to vendor master data in procurement system.

attributes.name: allergen_eggs

attributes.name: allergen_fish
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain fish. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_milk
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain milk or dairy derivatives. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_peanuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain peanuts. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_shellfish

attributes.name: allergen_soybeans
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain soybeans. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_tree_nuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain tree nuts. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_wheat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain wheat. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of individual units contained in one case. Used for ordering and receiving conversions.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the standard cost (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock item record was first created in the inventory management system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the item was or will be discontinued from inventory. Used for phase-out planning and historical analysis.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: International product identifier used for supply chain tracking and barcode scanning. May be UPC, EAN, or other GS1 format.

attributes.name: haccp_max_temp_f
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Maximum Temperature Fahrenheit
attributes.description: Maximum safe storage temperature in Fahrenheit to maintain product quality and food safety standards.
