attributes.name: reversal_adjustment_inventory_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adjustment record that reversed this adjustment, if applicable.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock keeping unit (SKU) being adjusted.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location (walk-in, dry storage, freezer) where the adjusted inventory is held.

attributes.name: adjusted_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory adjusted, expressed in the stock item's unit of measure. Positive values indicate increases to on-hand inventory; negative values indicate decreases.

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the inventory adjustment was recorded and applied to on-hand balances.

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the inventory adjustment transaction. Format: ADJ-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the inventory adjustment transaction was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory adjustment indicating the nature of the non-standard inventory movement (positive adjustment, negative adjustment, write-off, theft, breakage, spoilage, system correction, transfer correction, count reconciliation, damaged goods, expired product, vendor credit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: positive adjustment|negative adjustment|write-off|theft|breakage|spoilage|system correction|transfer correction|count reconciliation|damaged goods|expired product|vendor credit — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: adjustment_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the inventory adjustment, calculated as adjusted quantity multiplied by unit cost. Positive values increase inventory asset value; negative values decrease it.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the inventory adjustment (pending, approved, rejected, auto-approved).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the manager approved the inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: approved_by_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager who approved the inventory adjustment, captured for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number of the stock item being adjusted, used for traceability and food safety compliance under Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with the restaurant unit or department responsible for the inventory adjustment, used for Profit and Loss (P&L) allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory adjustment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the adjustment value (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-by date of the stock item being adjusted, relevant for adjustments due to expired product removal.

attributes.name: impacts_cogs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Impacts Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory adjustment impacts the restaurant unit's Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) percentage calculation.

tag_set.value: Impacts Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Flag

attributes.name: is_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory adjustment has been reversed by a subsequent correcting adjustment.

attributes.name: is_shrinkage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment represents inventory shrinkage (unexplained loss, theft, or discrepancy between physical count and system records).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory adjustment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments providing context, details, or special instructions related to the inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity_after
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity for this stock item at this location immediately after the adjustment was applied.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity_before
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity for this stock item at this location immediately before the adjustment was applied.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific business reason for the adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: THEFT|DAMAGE|SPOIL|EXPIRE|RECOUNT|SYSCORR|XFERERR|VNDCRED|BREAK|SPILL|MISREC|OVERPOUR|PORTIONERR|TEMPFAIL|RECALL — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing detailed explanation of why the inventory adjustment was necessary.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment type or value threshold requires manager approval before being applied to inventory balances.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for supporting documentation (e.g., incident report number, physical count sheet ID, vendor credit memo number, manager approval form) that justifies the adjustment.

attributes.name: temperature_at_adjustment_f
attributes.description: The recorded storage temperature in Fahrenheit at the time of adjustment, relevant for temperature-related spoilage or HACCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - HACCP Temperature Controls

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the stock item at the time of adjustment, used to calculate the total adjustment value.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the adjusted quantity is expressed (each, case, pound, kilogram, ounce, liter, gallon, box, bag, pallet). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|box|bag|pallet — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waste_category
attributes.description: Classification of waste type for adjustments related to inventory loss, used for waste percentage (Waste%) tracking and analysis (operational waste, spoilage, theft, damage, other).

products.name: food_cost_period
products.description: Period-level food cost summary record for each restaurant unit, capturing the calculated COGS% for a defined accounting period (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly). Captures period start date, period end date, opening inventory value ($), purchases value ($), transfers-in value ($), transfers-out value ($), waste value ($), closing inventory value ($), theoretical food cost ($), actual food cost ($), COGS% actual, COGS% theoretical, variance ($), and variance percentage. The operational food cost control record — NOT an analytics aggregate but the posted period-close record used by restaurant managers and finance.

attributes.name: food_cost_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the food cost period record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Food‑cost period calculations consider campaign impact on COGS; linking provides the necessary data for cost‑impact reports.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links periodic food‑cost calculations to cost centers for departmental profitability reporting.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: add column financial_period_id (BIGINT) with FK to finance.financial_period.financial_period_id - food cost periods should align with financial periods for P&L reconciliation

attributes.name: food_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who reviewed and approved this food cost period record. Typically a district manager, area director, or finance controller.

attributes.name: food_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who closed and finalized this food cost period. Typically a restaurant manager or accounting staff member.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Food‑cost period statements are aggregated per franchisee for royalty and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: primary_food_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who closed and finalized this food cost period. Typically a restaurant manager or accounting staff member.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit for which this food cost period is calculated. Links to the specific restaurant location.

attributes.name: actual_food_cost
attributes.description: The actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for the period, calculated as: Opening Inventory + Purchases + Transfers In - Transfers Out - Closing Inventory. The real food cost incurred.
attributes.references: GAAP Cost of Goods Sold Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any manual adjustments applied to the food cost calculation for the period, such as corrections for inventory errors, vendor credits, or accounting reclassifications. Positive or negative value.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual adjustment applied to the food cost calculation. Provides audit trail and justification for period adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period was reviewed and approved by management. Indicates final sign-off on the period results.

attributes.name: beverage_sales_revenue
attributes.description: The total beverage sales revenue for the period. Tracked separately from food sales for category-specific cost analysis.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period was officially closed and calculations were finalized. Marks the completion of the period-close process.

attributes.name: closing_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of food inventory on hand at the end of the period, determined by physical count or perpetual inventory system. Represents the ending stock value for COGS calculation.

attributes.name: cogs_percent_actual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage Actual
attributes.description: The actual food cost as a percentage of food sales revenue for the period. Key performance metric for restaurant profitability and cost control. Calculated as (Actual Food Cost / Food Sales Revenue) * 100.

tag_set.value: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage Actual

attributes.name: cogs_percent_theoretical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage Theoretical
attributes.description: The theoretical food cost as a percentage of food sales revenue for the period. Represents the ideal COGS% if all operational standards were met. Calculated as (Theoretical Food Cost / Food Sales Revenue) * 100.

tag_set.value: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage Theoretical

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine closing inventory value: physical (manual count), perpetual (system-tracked), or hybrid (system with periodic physical verification).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period record was first created in the system. Marks the initiation of the period tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international restaurant chains.

attributes.name: food_sales_revenue
attributes.description: The total food sales revenue (excluding beverage) for the period. Used as the denominator in COGS% calculations. Sourced from Point of Sale (POS) system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this food cost period, such as unusual events, operational issues, inventory discrepancies, or explanations for variance. Used for management review and audit purposes.

attributes.name: opening_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of food inventory on hand at the beginning of the period. Represents the starting stock value for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the accounting period for which food costs are being calculated. Marks the close of the cost accumulation window.

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: The accounting period identifier in format YYYY-PNN (e.g., 2024-P01 for period 1 of 2024). Used for financial reporting alignment.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the accounting period for which food costs are being calculated. Marks the beginning of the cost accumulation window.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: The current status of the food cost period: open (still accepting transactions), closed (period ended, calculations complete), locked (finalized, no further changes allowed), or under_review (being audited or reviewed).

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The frequency type of the accounting period for food cost calculation (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly).

attributes.name: physical_count_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical inventory count was performed to determine closing inventory value. Typically the last day of the period or the first day of the next period.

attributes.name: purchases_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of all food and beverage purchases received during the period. Includes all vendor invoices posted to inventory during the period.

attributes.name: theoretical_food_cost
attributes.description: The calculated ideal food cost based on recipe costing and actual sales mix (PMIX). Represents what food cost should have been if all recipes were followed perfectly with no waste or theft.

attributes.name: total_sales_revenue
attributes.description: The combined food and beverage sales revenue for the period. Represents total top-line revenue for the restaurant unit during the period.

attributes.name: transfers_in_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of inventory transferred into this restaurant unit from other locations during the period. Increases available inventory.

attributes.name: transfers_out_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of inventory transferred out of this restaurant unit to other locations during the period. Decreases available inventory.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The dollar difference between actual food cost and theoretical food cost (Actual - Theoretical). Positive variance indicates higher-than-expected costs due to waste, theft, portioning errors, or recipe non-compliance.

attributes.name: variance_percent
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of theoretical food cost. Calculated as (Variance Amount / Theoretical Food Cost) * 100. Used to assess the magnitude of cost control issues.

attributes.name: waste_percent
attributes.description: The waste value as a percentage of total food usage (Waste Value / (Actual Food Cost + Waste Value)) * 100. Key metric for food quality control and operational efficiency.

attributes.name: waste_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of food waste recorded during the period, including spoilage, expiration, preparation errors, and quality control discards. Tracked for Waste% calculation and food cost control.

products.name: uom
products.description: Reference master for all units of measure used in inventory transactions — ordering UOM, storage UOM, and recipe UOM — plus their conversion factors. Captures UOM code, UOM name, UOM type (weight/volume/count/length), base UOM flag, and applicable item categories. Conversion detail: from-UOM, to-UOM, stock-item-specific overrides (item-specific conversions override global defaults), conversion factor, effective date, and source (vendor spec/lab measurement/standard). Supports accurate translation between ordering (case of 6), storage (each), and recipe (ounce/gram) contexts — critical for inventory valuation and COGS% calculation across all restaurant units.

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the unit of measure. Primary key.

attributes.name: base_uom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the base UOM for this measurement type. Used to establish conversion chains. Null if this UOM is itself the base unit.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short form or symbol for the UOM (e.g., lb, oz, gal, kg, g, ml). Used in compact displays, labels, and Kitchen Display System (KDS) screens.

attributes.name: allows_fractional_quantities
attributes.description: Indicates whether fractional quantities are permitted for this UOM (e.g., 2.5 pounds allowed, but 2.5 cases may not be). Enforces business rules in inventory transactions and recipe scaling.

attributes.name: allows_temperature_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items measured in this UOM require Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) temperature monitoring during storage and transfer. Supports food safety compliance per Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations.

attributes.name: applicable_item_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) categories or commodity types where this UOM is applicable (e.g., dry goods, produce, dairy, beverages, proteins). Supports context-aware UOM selection in ordering and recipe management.

attributes.name: uom_category
attributes.description: Measurement system category (metric, imperial, count-based, or custom). Supports multi-region operations with different measurement standards.

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the unit of measure (e.g., EA, CS, LB, OZ, GAL, KG, G, ML, L). Used as the business identifier in inventory transactions and recipe management.

attributes.name: conversion_factor_to_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Conversion Factor to Base Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Multiplier to convert this UOM to the base UOM (e.g., 1 pound = 453.592 grams, so conversion_factor_to_base = 453.592). Critical for accurate Cost of Goods Sold (COGS%) calculation and yield management across ordering, storage, and recipe contexts.

tag_set.value: Conversion Factor to Base Unit of Measure (UOM)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this UOM record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking per Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) requirements.

attributes.name: default_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Default shelf life in days for items measured in this UOM. Used as a fallback when Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)-specific shelf life is not defined. Supports waste tracking (Waste%) and First In First Out (FIFO) rotation.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Sort order for displaying UOMs in user interfaces and dropdown lists. Lower numbers appear first. Supports user experience optimization in Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management systems.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this UOM was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active UOMs. Supports historical reporting and audit trails for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS%) analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this UOM became available for use in inventory transactions. Supports temporal validity and historical analysis of UOM changes.

attributes.name: is_base_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Base Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is the base unit for its type (e.g., gram for weight, milliliter for volume). Base UOMs have a conversion factor of 1.0 and serve as the reference for all conversions within their type.

tag_set.value: Is Base Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag

attributes.name: is_system_standard
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is a system-defined standard (e.g., gram, liter, each) that cannot be modified or deleted by users. Protects core reference data integrity.

attributes.name: iso_code
attributes.description: ISO 80000 standard code for the unit of measure. Supports international operations and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this UOM record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data governance for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS%) accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: uom_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit of measure (e.g., Each, Case, Pound, Ounce, Gallon, Kilogram, Gram, Milliliter, Liter). Human-readable label for reporting and user interfaces.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, usage guidelines, or special handling instructions for this UOM. Supports operational documentation and training materials.

attributes.name: ordering_uom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in purchase orders and vendor ordering (e.g., case, pallet). Supports procurement workflows and vendor catalog integration.

attributes.name: plural_name
attributes.description: Plural form of the UOM name (e.g., Pounds, Ounces, Cases). Supports grammatically correct reporting and user interface text generation.

attributes.name: precision_decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to use when displaying or calculating quantities in this UOM. Ensures consistent rounding and precision across inventory transactions.

attributes.name: recipe_uom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in recipe Bill of Materials (BOM) and menu item costing (e.g., ounce, gram, tablespoon). Critical for accurate recipe yield management and menu engineering.

attributes.name: requires_lot_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items measured in this UOM require lot number and expiration date tracking for traceability. Supports food safety recalls and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: storage_uom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used for Back of House (BOH) inventory storage and stock tracking (e.g., each, bag, box). Supports Periodic Automatic Replenishment (PAR) level management and cycle counts.

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard international symbol for the UOM (e.g., °F, °C, %, #). Used in scientific and regulatory contexts, particularly for Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) temperature monitoring.

attributes.name: un_cefact_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Centre for Trade Facilitation and Electronic Business (UN/CEFACT) Code
attributes.description: Standardized UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 code for the unit of measure. Supports Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration with suppliers and third-party logistics providers.

tag_set.value: United Nations Centre for Trade Facilitation and Electronic Business (UN/CEFACT) Code

products.name: vendor_item

products.name: lot_tracking

Captures lot number, stock item reference, supplier reference, receiving order reference, received date, manufacture date, expiration date, quantity received, quantity remaining, storage location, recall flag, and quarantine status. Supports HACCP traceability requirements, FDA recall response, and FIFO/FEFO rotation compliance.

products.name: prep_usage
products.description: Records the consumption of raw ingredients during BOH food preparation activities — the actual ingredient usage pulled from inventory to fulfill prep tasks and production schedules. Captures prep date, shift, station, stock item consumed, quantity used, unit of measure, theoretical usage (from BOM/recipe), actual usage, variance quantity, variance value ($), prep task reference, and recorded-by employee. Bridges inventory depletion with recipe/BOM standards from the menu domain, enabling theoretical vs. actual COGS% comparison.
products.reference: Ingredient Usage / BOH Consumption / Theoretical vs Actual

attributes.name: prep_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prep usage record. Primary key for the prep usage transaction.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Prep usage data is allocated to franchisees for labor and ingredient cost attribution.

attributes.name: primary_prep_recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who recorded the prep usage transaction. Supports accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recipe or BOM (Bill of Materials) that defines the theoretical ingredient usage. Links to the menu domain recipe master.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where the prep activity occurred. Links to the restaurant operations domain.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the raw ingredient or stock item consumed during prep. Links to the inventory stock item master.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The total dollar cost of the actual quantity used (actual_quantity_used multiplied by unit_cost). Contributes to actual COGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage).

attributes.name: actual_quantity_used
attributes.description: The actual quantity of the ingredient consumed during prep, as recorded by the BOH (Back of House) team. This is the real-world usage that depletes inventory.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The internal batch or production run number assigned to the prep output. Links multiple ingredient pulls to a single production batch.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this prep usage record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Supports multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-by date of the ingredient lot consumed. Ensures FIFO (First In First Out) compliance and food safety.

attributes.name: haccp_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prep activity met HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) temperature and handling requirements. True if compliant, False if not.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: The description of the stock item consumed. Denormalized to preserve historical context even if the item master changes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this prep usage record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number of the ingredient consumed. Critical for traceability and food safety compliance under HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the prep usage transaction. Captures contextual information for variance investigation or operational insights.

attributes.name: prep_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the prep activity occurred. Used for daily food cost tracking and COGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage) analysis.

attributes.name: prep_station_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the BOH (Back of House) prep station where the ingredient was consumed. Examples include grill, fry, salad, bakery, or assembly.

attributes.name: prep_station_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the prep station. Provides context for operational reporting and training.

attributes.name: prep_task_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or identifier for the specific prep task or production batch. Used to group related ingredient pulls for a single prep activity.

attributes.name: prep_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the prep activity was performed. Enables shift-level and intra-day analysis of BOH (Back of House) production.

attributes.name: prep_type
attributes.description: The type or purpose of the prep activity. Distinguishes between batch production, made-to-order, PAR (Periodic Automatic Replenishment) level restocking, and other prep scenarios.

attributes.name: prep_usage_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the prep usage record. Supports workflow management and data quality controls.

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: The quality grade assigned to the prep output. Used to track prep quality and identify training or process improvement needs.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code of the ingredient consumed. Denormalized for reporting convenience and historical accuracy.

attributes.name: temperature_at_prep_f
attributes.description: The temperature in Fahrenheit at which the ingredient was stored or handled during prep. Critical for HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) compliance.

attributes.name: theoretical_cost
attributes.description: The total dollar cost of the theoretical quantity (theoretical_quantity multiplied by unit_cost). Used for theoretical COGS% calculation.

attributes.name: theoretical_quantity
attributes.description: The theoretical quantity of the ingredient that should have been used according to the recipe or BOM (Bill of Materials). Used for variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of measure for the ingredient at the time of prep. Used to calculate the dollar value of usage and variance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity used. Examples include lb, kg, oz, gal, L, ea (each), case, or portion.

attributes.name: variance_cost
attributes.description: The dollar value of the variance (actual_cost minus theoretical_cost). Quantifies the financial impact of over- or under-usage.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance quantity expressed as a percentage of the theoretical quantity. Enables standardized comparison across different ingredients and recipes.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between actual and theoretical quantity used (actual minus theoretical). Positive values indicate over-usage; negative values indicate under-usage.

attributes.name: waste_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any waste or over-usage. Used to categorize and analyze sources of food waste and variance. domains.name: restaurant

products.name: unit
products.description: Master record for every restaurant unit — company-owned and franchised. The authoritative identity of each physical location including unit number, brand, concept type (QSR/casual/fine-dining), ownership model (company-owned vs. franchised), legal entity name, trade name, opening date, closure date, current operational status, and geographic coordinates. This is the operational anchor for the entire restaurant domain and the primary FK target for all cross-domain joins (order, inventory, workforce, finance, franchise). products.name: format_config
products.description: Defines the operational format, physical configuration, and total capacity of a restaurant unit. Includes dining format (QSR, fast-casual, casual, fine-dining), service model (counter, table, drive-thru, kiosk), FOH layout (total indoor seating capacity, outdoor/patio seating capacity, bar seating count, private dining room capacity, ADA-compliant seating count, table count, cover count), BOH layout (kitchen footprint sq ft, cooking lines, prep stations), drive-thru configuration (lane count, stacking capacity for vehicles), kiosk count, counter service positions, and maximum cover count per daypart. products.name: throughput_benchmark
products.description: Defines throughput capacity benchmarks and speed-of-service (SOS) targets for each restaurant unit by service channel (DT drive-thru, counter, OLO online, 3PD third-party delivery) and daypart. Captures target ticket time (seconds), target throughput (covers/hour or transactions/hour), ADT (Average Daily Transactions) target, ATC (Average Transaction Count) target, ACV (Average Check Value) target, table turn target (minutes), and cover count capacity. Used for operational performance benchmarking and SOS compliance.

attributes.name: sos_compliance_threshold_pct

attributes.name: target_acv

attributes.name: throughput_benchmark_status

products.name: sos_measurement
products.description: Transactional records of actual speed-of-service (SOS), throughput measurements, and table turn events captured per service event at each restaurant unit across all channels. For drive-thru/counter/kiosk/OLO: captures measurement timestamp, service channel, daypart, order-to-ready time, order-to-delivery time, ticket time, queue wait time, and measurement source (POS timer, KDS, sensor). For dine-in table service: captures table identifier, cover count, seating time, order-placed time, food-delivered time, check-presented time, table-cleared time, total turn time, server station, party size, and table status transitions. This is the single source of truth for all operational timing and throughput measurements across every service model. Enables unified SOS trend analysis, table turn rate optimization, cover count tracking, FOH throughput benchmarking, and benchmark gap identification.

attributes.name: sos_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each speed-of-service measurement event. Primary key for the SOS measurement transactional record.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the daypart during which this measurement occurred (breakfast, lunch, dinner, late-night). Links to daypart reference data.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest order associated with this SOS measurement. Links to the order transaction record captured in the POS system.

attributes.name: sos_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where this SOS measurement was captured. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: sos_target_id

attributes.name: sos_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where this SOS measurement was captured. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOS measurement record was first created in the data system, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: equipment_issue_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any equipment malfunction or issue was reported during this service event. True if equipment issue was logged; False otherwise.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of any exceptional circumstances that impacted service time for this measurement. Examples include equipment failure, staff shortage, system outage, or unusual order requirements.

attributes.name: guest_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) rating provided by the guest for this service event, typically on a scale of 1-5. Captured via receipt survey, mobile app feedback, or kiosk prompt.

attributes.name: measurement_quality_score
attributes.description: Data quality score for this measurement record, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00. Reflects completeness, accuracy, and reliability of the captured timing data. Lower scores indicate potential data quality issues.

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: System or device that captured the SOS measurement. Point of Sale (POS) timer, Kitchen Display System (KDS), drive-thru sensor array, manual staff entry, Online Ordering (OLO) platform, or third-party delivery API.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the speed-of-service measurement was captured, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Represents the business event time of the service completion.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOS measurement record was last modified in the data system, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) rating provided by the guest for this service event, typically on a scale of 0-10. Measures guest loyalty and likelihood to recommend.

attributes.name: order_complexity_score
attributes.description: Calculated complexity score for the order based on item count, customizations, and preparation requirements. Higher scores indicate more complex orders that may require longer service times.

attributes.name: order_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of menu items in the order associated with this SOS measurement. Used to analyze SOS performance relative to order complexity.

attributes.name: order_to_delivery_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from order placement to order delivered to guest. Includes preparation time plus handoff time. End-to-end service time metric.

attributes.name: order_to_ready_time_seconds
attributes.description: Elapsed time in seconds from order placement to order ready for pickup or delivery. Measured from POS order entry timestamp to Kitchen Display System (KDS) completion timestamp.

attributes.name: peak_period_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the measurement occurred during a designated peak service period. True for peak hours; False for off-peak hours.

attributes.name: queue_depth_count
attributes.description: Number of vehicles or guests in the service queue at the time of measurement. Indicates throughput capacity and congestion level.

attributes.name: queue_wait_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds the guest or vehicle spent waiting in queue before placing order. Applicable primarily to Drive-Thru (DT) and counter service channels.

attributes.name: service_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the guest order was placed and fulfilled. Drive-Thru (DT), Front of House (FOH) counter, self-service kiosk, Online Ordering (OLO), Third-Party Delivery (3PD), or curbside pickup.

attributes.name: service_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether service recovery actions were taken for this order due to SOS delays or other service failures. True if recovery actions were applied; False otherwise.

attributes.name: staff_count_on_duty
attributes.description: Number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) staff members on duty in the service area at the time of measurement. Used to correlate staffing levels with SOS performance.

attributes.name: target_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the SOS measurement met or exceeded the target benchmark. True if actual time was at or below target; False if actual time exceeded target.

attributes.name: target_variance_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between actual order-to-delivery time and the SOS target benchmark. Positive values indicate slower than target; negative values indicate faster than target.

attributes.name: ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds the order ticket was active in the kitchen or service queue. Represents Back of House (BOH) processing duration from ticket creation to fulfillment.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the restaurant location during the measurement period. Used to analyze external factors impacting drive-thru and curbside service times. products.name: brand_standard
products.description: Defines the brand standards and SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) applicable to each restaurant unit by concept type and ownership model. Captures standard code, standard name, standard category (food quality, cleanliness, service, safety, brand presentation), applicable format (QSR/casual/fine-dining), compliance requirement level (mandatory/recommended), effective date, expiry date, governing body reference (NRA, FDA, OSHA), and linked SOP document reference. Operational anchor for audit and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: service_score

attributes.name: visit_category

attributes.name: visit_date

attributes.name: visit_duration_minutes

attributes.name: visit_end_timestamp

attributes.name: visit_notes

attributes.name: visit_number

attributes.name: visit_priority_level

attributes.name: visit_start_timestamp

attributes.name: visit_status

products.name: ops_visit_finding
products.description: Line-item findings recorded during an operational field visit at a restaurant unit. Each record captures the parent visit reference, finding category (food safety, cleanliness, equipment, service, brand standard, labor), finding description, severity level (critical, major, minor, observation), brand standard violated, corrective action required, corrective action due date, corrective action completed flag, and completion date. Enables granular compliance gap tracking and repeat-finding trend analysis.

attributes.name: ops_visit_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the operational visit finding record. Primary key.

attributes.name: auditor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the auditor who recorded this finding. Links to workforce management system for auditor credentials and certification tracking.

attributes.name: ops_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where this finding was observed. Links to the restaurant product.

attributes.name: ops_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where this finding was observed. Links to the restaurant product.

attributes.name: ops_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent operational field visit during which this finding was recorded. Links to the ops_visit product.

attributes.name: previous_finding_ops_visit_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ops_visit_finding_id of the prior occurrence if this is a repeat finding. Enables tracking of finding recurrence patterns and corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.name: primary_ops_employee_id
attributes.description: Name of the manager or executive who approved the waiver. Populated only when status is waived. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the field auditor or inspector who recorded this finding during the operational visit. Used for auditor performance tracking and finding validation.

attributes.name: brand_standard_code
attributes.description: Reference code for the specific brand standard or SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) that was violated or not met. Links to the brand standards repository for detailed requirement documentation.

attributes.name: brand_standard_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the brand standard or SOP that was violated. Examples: Hand Washing Protocol, Temperature Log Maintenance, Uniform and Appearance Standard, Drive-Thru Speed of Service.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required corrective action has been completed and verified. True when action is complete and verified; False when pending or in progress.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed and verified. Populated when corrective_action_completed_flag is set to True. Used to calculate resolution time and track overdue items.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the corrective action must be completed. Set based on severity level: critical findings typically require same-day or next-day resolution, major findings within 7 days, minor findings within 30 days.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action that must be taken to resolve the finding. Specifies what needs to be done, by whom, and any specific requirements or standards that must be met.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Framework, HACCP Corrective Action Procedures

attributes.name: corrective_action_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the corrective action was completed satisfactorily. Options include on-site inspection by field manager, photographic evidence submitted by unit, document review, manager attestation, or scheduled follow-up visit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this finding record was first created in the system. System-generated audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Organizational level to which this finding has been escalated. Unit: handled at restaurant level. Area: escalated to area manager. Region: escalated to regional director. Corporate: escalated to corporate compliance or executive leadership.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding requires escalation beyond the restaurant unit level to area management, regional leadership, or corporate compliance. True for critical findings, repeat major findings, or regulatory violations requiring senior leadership notification.

attributes.name: financial_impact_usd
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the finding in US dollars. May include cost of waste, potential fines, equipment repair costs, or revenue impact from service disruption. Used for prioritization and ROI analysis of corrective actions.

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the finding type. Categories include food safety (HACCP violations, temperature control), cleanliness (sanitation, hygiene), equipment (maintenance, functionality), service (guest experience, speed of service), brand standard (SOP compliance, visual standards), labor (staffing, scheduling, training), and inventory (stock levels, waste management). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_safety|cleanliness|equipment|service|brand_standard|labor|inventory — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NRA ServSafe Standards, FDA Food Code, Internal Brand Standards Manual

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the observed finding. Captures what was observed, where it was observed, and the specific condition or behavior that triggered the finding. Free-text field for auditor notes.

attributes.name: finding_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of findings within the parent visit. Used to maintain the order in which findings were recorded during the field visit.

attributes.name: finding_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the finding category. Examples: temperature_control, hand_washing, equipment_calibration, uniform_compliance, waste_tracking. Provides granular segmentation for trend analysis.

attributes.name: finding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the finding was observed and recorded during the field visit. Captures the precise moment of observation for time-sensitive findings such as temperature violations or service delays.

attributes.name: guest_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding has direct impact on guest experience, satisfaction, or safety. True if the finding affects FOH (Front of House) operations, service quality, food safety, or guest-facing brand standards; False if it is purely BOH (Back of House) or administrative.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this finding record was last updated. System-generated audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, context, or observations related to the finding. May include mitigating circumstances, root cause analysis, or special instructions for corrective action.

attributes.name: ops_visit_finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the finding. Open: newly recorded, awaiting action. In Progress: corrective action underway. Resolved: action completed, awaiting verification. Closed: verified and complete. Waived: finding acknowledged but action waived with justification.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to photographic evidence documenting the finding. Used for visual verification, training purposes, and dispute resolution. Links to document management system or cloud storage.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory code, section, or requirement that was violated. Examples: FDA Food Code 3-501.16, OSHA 1910.22, Local Health Code Section 12.4. Populated only when regulatory_violation_flag is True.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, OSHA Standards, Local Health Department Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding constitutes a violation of regulatory requirements (FDA, OSHA, local health department). True if the finding violates a legal or regulatory standard; False if it is an internal brand standard deviation only.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, OSHA Standards, Local Health Department Regulations

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a repeat of a previously identified issue at this restaurant unit. True if the same or similar finding was recorded in a prior visit; False if this is the first occurrence. Used to identify systemic compliance gaps.

attributes.name: repeat_occurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times this specific finding has been recorded at this restaurant unit. Incremented each time the same finding is observed in subsequent visits. Used for escalation and intervention triggers.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual assigned responsibility for completing the corrective action. Typically the restaurant general manager, area manager, or specific department lead depending on the finding category.

attributes.name: responsible_party_role
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual responsible for the corrective action. Examples: General Manager, Kitchen Manager, Area Manager, Facilities Manager, Training Coordinator.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of the finding's impact and urgency. Critical: immediate health/safety risk or major brand violation requiring immediate action. Major: significant compliance gap with potential regulatory or brand impact. Minor: deviation from standard with limited impact. Observation: opportunity for improvement without compliance violation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, OSHA Standards, Internal Compliance Framework

attributes.name: waiver_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the waiver was approved. Populated only when status is waived.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Justification for waiving the corrective action requirement. Populated only when status is waived. Requires approval from authorized manager and documentation of business rationale.

attributes.name: period_category

attributes.name: period_close_date

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Business-friendly code used to reference the period in reports and systems.

attributes.name: period_duration_days

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date included in this performance period. Defines the ending boundary for all transactions and metrics captured within this period.

attributes.name: period_lock_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance period was locked, preventing any further transactional or adjustment entries. Ensures data integrity for audited financial reporting.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the performance period (e.g., 'FY2024 Period 3', 'Q1 2024', 'Week 12'). Used for reporting displays and user interfaces.

attributes.name: period_number

attributes.name: period_start_date

attributes.name: period_status

attributes.name: period_type

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Master reference table for benefit_plan. Referenced by default_benefit_plan_id.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for benefit_plan

attributes.name: workday_benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this benefit plan in the Workday HCM system of record. Used for system integration, enrollment synchronization, and payroll deduction mapping.

attributes.name: aca_minimum_essential_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan qualifies as Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC) under the ACA, satisfying the individual mandate and employer shared responsibility requirements.

attributes.name: aca_minimum_value
attributes.description: Indicates whether this health plan meets the ACA minimum value standard (covers at least 60% of total allowed costs). Required for ACA employer mandate compliance and Form 1095-C reporting.

attributes.name: annual_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount an employee must pay out-of-pocket for covered services before the insurance carrier begins paying. Applicable primarily to medical and dental plans.

attributes.name: auto_enroll_default_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Default contribution percentage applied when an employee is auto-enrolled in a retirement plan. Null for non-auto-enroll plans or non-retirement plan types.

attributes.name: auto_enroll_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether eligible employees are automatically enrolled in this plan upon meeting eligibility criteria (e.g., 401(k) auto-enrollment). Employees may opt out after automatic enrollment.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or benefits administrator underwriting or administering this plan (e.g., Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Fidelity, Principal).

attributes.name: carrier_plan_code
attributes.description: The insurance carrier's own identifier for this plan, used for EDI 834 enrollment transmissions, claims adjudication, and carrier reconciliation.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan is subject to COBRA continuation coverage requirements, allowing terminated or qualifying-event-affected employees to continue coverage at their own cost.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Enrollment tier defining which dependents are covered under this plan election. Drives premium contribution calculations and payroll deduction amounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this benefit plan record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international restaurant brands.

attributes.name: deduction_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee premium contributions are deducted from payroll. Must align with the restaurant's payroll cycle configuration in Workday.

attributes.name: dependent_coverage_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether dependents (spouse, domestic partner, children) may be enrolled under this benefit plan. ACA requires dependent coverage up to age 26 for qualifying health plans.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit plan becomes active and available for employee enrollment. Marks the start of the plan year or mid-year amendment.

attributes.name: eligibility_waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days a new employee must be employed before becoming eligible to enroll in this benefit plan. ACA limits medical waiting periods to 90 days for qualifying health plans.

attributes.name: eligible_employee_class
attributes.description: Employee classification(s) eligible for this plan (e.g., full-time, part-time, salaried, hourly, manager, crew). Drives enrollment eligibility rules in Workday HCM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_time|part_time|salaried|hourly|manager|crew|seasonal|temporary — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount deducted from the employee's paycheck per pay period for this benefit plan at the applicable coverage tier. Drives payroll deduction setup in Workday.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the employer contributes per pay period toward the cost of this benefit plan per enrolled employee at the applicable coverage tier. Used in labor cost modeling and total compensation reporting.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total premium cost covered by the employer. Used when employer contribution is expressed as a percentage rather than a fixed amount (e.g., 80% of premium). Mutually informative with employer_contribution_amount.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number
attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned by the plan sponsor for DOL Form 5500 filing purposes. Required for ERISA-covered welfare and pension benefit plans.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit plan ceases to be available. Null for open-ended plans. Used to manage plan year transitions and sunset legacy offerings.

attributes.name: fsa_annual_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum annual employee contribution allowed to a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) under this plan. IRS sets the annual limit; this field captures the plan-specific limit which may be lower.

attributes.name: funding_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the plan is financially structured. Fully insured plans transfer risk to the carrier; self-funded plans retain risk with the employer; level-funded plans blend fixed monthly costs with self-insurance.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of plan availability. National plans are available to all eligible employees; regional or state plans may be offered in specific markets due to carrier network or regulatory differences.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Employer group number assigned by the insurance carrier, printed on member ID cards and used for claims processing and eligibility verification.

attributes.name: hsa_employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Annual dollar amount the employer seeds into the employee's Health Savings Account (HSA) for HSA-compatible High Deductible Health Plans (HDHPs). Null for non-HDHP plans.

attributes.name: minimum_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Minimum average weekly hours an employee must work to be eligible for this benefit plan. Critical for restaurant operations where part-time and variable-hour employees are common. ACA defines full-time as 30+ hours/week.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal administrative notes regarding plan amendments, carrier negotiations, compliance exceptions, or operational considerations. Not displayed to employees.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the annual open enrollment window. Elections made after this date require a qualifying life event.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the annual open enrollment window during which employees may elect, change, or waive coverage under this plan.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount an employee pays in a plan year before the carrier covers 100% of covered in-network costs. ACA-mandated limit for qualifying health plans.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the benefit plan, used in HR systems, payroll integrations, and employee communications (e.g., MED-PPO-2024, DEN-BASIC).

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the benefit plan summarizing key features, coverage highlights, and intended employee population. Used in HR communications and enrollment portals.

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system path to the official Summary Plan Description (SPD) or plan document. ERISA requires SPDs be provided to participants.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit plan as displayed to employees during open enrollment and on pay stubs (e.g., 'PPO Medical Gold', 'Basic Dental', '401(k) Standard').

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit plan. Active plans are available for enrollment; discontinued plans are closed to new enrollees but may retain existing participants.

attributes.name: plan_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification within the plan type, distinguishing plan design variants (e.g., PPO, HMO, HDHP for medical; term vs. whole for life; traditional vs. Roth for retirement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ppo|hmo|hdhp|epo|pos|term|whole|traditional|roth|basic|enhanced — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit coverage offered by this plan. Drives enrollment eligibility rules, payroll deduction codes, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life|disability|retirement|fsa|hsa|supplemental|commuter|legal|pet — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the benefit plan year. Marks the close of the annual benefit period for deductible accumulation, FSA use-or-lose deadlines, and ACA reporting.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the benefit plan year. Determines the annual reset of deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums, FSA/HSA contribution limits, and ACA reporting periods.

attributes.name: planday_integration_code
attributes.description: Reference code used to link this benefit plan to Planday scheduling and labor management system for labor cost allocation and benefit-eligible hours tracking.

attributes.name: pretax_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee contributions to this plan are deducted on a pre-tax basis under a Section 125 Cafeteria Plan, reducing the employee's taxable income.

attributes.name: retirement_match_cap_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of employee compensation up to which the employer match applies for retirement plans (e.g., employer matches 50% of contributions up to 6% of salary). Null for non-retirement plans.

attributes.name: retirement_match_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of employee 401(k) or retirement contributions matched by the employer, up to the match cap. Applicable only to retirement plan types. Null for non-retirement plans.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for state-specific benefit plans. Null for national plans. Used to apply state-mandated benefit requirements and carrier network restrictions.

attributes.name: summary_plan_description_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Summary Plan Description document associated with this plan, used to track amendments and ensure employees receive current plan information.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was last modified. Used to detect plan amendments, contribution rate changes, and eligibility rule updates.

attributes.name: vesting_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months required for full vesting of employer contributions under cliff or graded vesting schedules. Null for immediate vesting plans.

attributes.name: vesting_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of vesting schedule governing when employer contributions to retirement or equity plans become fully owned by the employee. Immediate vesting grants full ownership at enrollment; cliff and graded schedules apply time-based milestones.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on benefit_plan (default_benefit_plan_id)

products.name: agreement
products.description: Authoritative record of each franchise agreement between the franchisor and a franchisee, encompassing the full agreement lifecycle from execution through renewal, transfer, or termination. Captures agreement type (initial, renewal, transfer, successor), effective and expiration dates, territory grant, initial franchise fee, royalty rate and basis, marketing fund contribution rate, renewal terms, and agreement status. Owns all lifecycle event records including: transfers (transferor/transferee, ROFR exercise, approval, transfer conditions, effective date), renewals (updated terms, FDD re-disclosure, renewal fee, execution date), and terminations (type, default notice, cure period, de-identification, post-termination obligations, non-compete). SSOT for all contractual franchise obligations and their complete lifecycle history. Supports FTC Franchise Rule Items 5, 6, 17 disclosure requirements.

Managed via Zenput. Supports QA compliance tracking, trend analysis, and regulatory reporting. Each audit contains zero-to-many findings as line items.

products.name: foodsafety_corrective_action

attributes.name: stock_location_id

attributes.name: allergen_control_flag

attributes.name: chemicals_used

attributes.name: compliance_flag

attributes.name: corrective_actions

attributes.name: findings_description

attributes.name: next_service_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: pests_identified

attributes.name: recommendations

attributes.name: record_status

attributes.name: regulatory_reference

attributes.name: service_order_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned to the pest control service request.

attributes.name: service_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the pest control vendor or contractor.

attributes.name: service_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service record.

attributes.name: service_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pest control service was executed.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Category of pest control activity performed.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of pest infestation severity.

attributes.name: severity_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1‑5) representing infestation severity.

attributes.name: temperature_log_reference
attributes.description: Identifier linking to related temperature monitoring records, if applicable.

attributes.name: treatment_method
attributes.description: Technique used to address the pest issue (e.g., baiting, spraying, trapping).

products.name: foodsafety_supplier_certification
products.description: Master record of food safety certifications and compliance documents held by food and beverage suppliers, including certification type (SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000, GlobalG.A.P., USDA Organic), issuing body, scope of certification, issue date, expiration date, and current approval status. Supports approved supplier program management and FSMA Preventive Controls compliance.
products.reference: Supplier Certification — FSMA PCHF / SQF / BRC / FSSC 22000

attributes.name: foodsafety_supplier_certification_id

attributes.name: supply_supplier_id

products.name: receiving_inspection
products.description: Transactional record of food and supply receiving inspections conducted at a restaurant unit's back-of-house (BOH) dock, capturing delivery date, supplier, product/SKU received, lot number, quantity, temperature at receiving, visual quality check result (pass/fail), rejection reason if applicable, and inspector identity. products.reference: Receiving Inspection — HACCP Receiving CCP / FDA FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: receiving_inspection_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: audit_reference

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: product_name

attributes.name: product_sku

attributes.name: quantity_received

attributes.name: receiving_date

attributes.name: receiving_inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: temperature_celsius

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit

attributes.name: temperature_pass_flag

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: visual_quality_pass

products.name: food_safety_training
products.description: Transactional record of food safety training sessions completed by restaurant employees, including training program name, training type (onboarding, annual refresher, corrective retraining, allergen awareness), delivery method (in-person, e-learning, Zenput), completion date, assessment score, pass/fail status, and trainer or platform identity. attributes.description: System‑generated unique identifier for each food safety training record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: food_employee_id

attributes.name: food_restaurant_unit_id

attributes.name: primary_food_employee_id

attributes.name: assessment_score

attributes.name: completion_timestamp

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: pass_fail_status

attributes.name: training_status

attributes.name: training_type

products.name: environmental_monitoring
products.description: Transactional record of environmental monitoring samples collected at restaurant units, including sample type (swab, sponge, air plate), target organism (Listeria monocytogenes, Salmonella spp., E. coli, total plate count), sampling location (food contact surface, non-food contact surface, drain, floor), sample date, collected by, laboratory results, pass/fail against established limits, corrective action triggered flag, and zone classification (Zone 1-4). Supports pathogen environmental monitoring programs (EMPs) required by FSMA Preventive Controls and large QSR chain food safety standards.

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental_monitoring data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: resampled_environmental_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on environmental_monitoring (resampled_environmental_monitoring_id)

attributes.description: add column restaurant_unit_id (BIGINT) with FK to restaurant.unit.unit_id - environmental monitoring samples must be traceable to a specific restaurant unit

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Environmental monitoring (e.g., humidity) is performed at storage locations; linking ties readings to the location.

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Manages guest loyalty program enrollment, membership tiers, points accrual and redemption, rewards catalog, promotional offers, personalized campaigns, member engagement, and loyalty analytics. Drives repeat visits, ACV lift, and customer lifetime value through targeted incentives and gamification across OLO and POS channels.
domains.references: PCI DSS, CRM Best Practices, Olo Digital Ordering Platform

products.name: member
products.description: Master record for every enrolled loyalty program member. Captures member identity linkage (guest_id FK to guest domain), enrollment channel (OLO, POS, in-app, kiosk, staff-assisted), enrollment date, current tier assignment, lifetime points earned/redeemed, opt-in preferences, program assignment, auto-accrue payment linkage flag, and program status (active, suspended, churned). This is the SSOT for loyalty membership identity — distinct from the guest profile master in the guest domain.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program member. Primary key for the member entity.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for assigning a dedicated employee to manage high‑value members, enabling personalized service and performance reporting.

attributes.name: acquisition_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Acquisition Campaign Attribution report requires linking each new member to the marketing campaign that drove the sign‑up, enabling ROI calculation of acquisition spend.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Supports franchisee‑level loyalty analytics by linking each member to the owning franchisee, used in franchise performance dashboards.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Member activity must be consolidated under the owning legal entity (franchise) for statutory financial statements.

attributes.name: member_guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the guest domain master record. Links loyalty membership to the guest profile system of record.

attributes.name: member_preferred_location_unit_id
attributes.description: Restaurant location that the member visits most frequently or has designated as their preferred location. Used for personalized offers and location-based campaigns.

attributes.name: member_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the guest domain master record. Links loyalty membership to the guest profile system of record.

attributes.name: member_unit_id
attributes.description: Restaurant location where the member enrolled, if enrollment occurred at a physical location. Null for digital enrollments.

attributes.name: primary_member_preferred_location_unit_id
attributes.description: Restaurant location that the member visits most frequently or has designated as their preferred location. Used for personalized offers and location-based campaigns.

attributes.name: referred_by_member_id
attributes.description: Member ID of the existing member who referred this member to the loyalty program. Null if member enrolled without a referral.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.site. Business justification: Needed for site‑specific loyalty marketing and reporting; members are assigned a primary restaurant site.

attributes.name: account_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty membership was closed or terminated. Null for active memberships. Used for retention analysis and right-to-be-forgotten compliance.
attributes.references: Loyalty Program Business Rules; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: account_closure_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for account closure. Examples: member request, fraud, inactivity, duplicate account, policy violation, data privacy request.

attributes.name: account_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the loyalty member record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: account_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the loyalty member record was last modified. Audit field for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: badges_earned
attributes.description: Total number of achievement badges earned by the member through gamification activities, challenges, and milestones.

attributes.name: birthday_month
attributes.description: Month of the member's birthday (1-12). Stored without year or day for privacy. Used for birthday reward campaigns and personalized offers.

attributes.name: current_points_balance
attributes.description: Current available points balance that the member can redeem. Calculated as lifetime earned minus lifetime redeemed minus expired points.

attributes.name: current_tier
attributes.description: Current membership tier level in the loyalty program hierarchy. Determines benefits, rewards multipliers, and exclusive offers available to the member.

attributes.name: data_privacy_consent_date
attributes.description: Date when the member provided explicit consent for data collection, processing, and storage under applicable privacy regulations.

attributes.name: direct_mail_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive physical direct mail offers and communications. True if opted in, False if opted out.

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive promotional and transactional emails. True if opted in, False if opted out.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the guest enrolled in the loyalty program. OLO (Online Ordering), POS (Point of Sale), mobile app, website, in-restaurant kiosk, or call center.
attributes.references: Olo Digital Ordering Platform; Oracle MICROS POS

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Marks the start of the member lifecycle.

attributes.name: gamification_level
attributes.description: Current level in the loyalty program gamification system. Members progress through levels by completing challenges, earning badges, and accumulating points.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent loyalty program activity by the member, including points earned, points redeemed, or profile updates. Used for churn prediction and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
