attributes.description: Channel through which the offer was originally distributed to the member. Distinct from redemption_channel which captures where it was redeemed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push_notification|in_app|direct_mail|receipt_print|social_media — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: offer_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the offer expires and can no longer be redeemed. Captured at redemption time for historical tracking.

attributes.name: original_order_amount
attributes.description: Total order amount before the offer discount was applied. Used to calculate discount impact and ACV (Average Check Value) lift.

attributes.name: points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points earned by the member on this transaction after the offer discount was applied. May be zero if offer disqualifies points accrual.

attributes.name: points_multiplier_applied
attributes.description: Points multiplier applied to this transaction if the offer included accelerated points accrual (e.g., 2x points, 3x points). Default is 1.0 for standard accrual.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the offer was redeemed. POS (Point of Sale) for in-store counter, OLO (Online Ordering) for web/app orders, drive_thru for drive-through lane, kiosk for self-service terminals, mobile_app for native app, third_party_delivery for 3PD (Third-Party Delivery) platforms.

attributes.name: redemption_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code presented by the member to redeem the offer. May be system-generated or campaign-specific.

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current status of the offer redemption. Fulfilled indicates successful redemption and discount applied, voided indicates redemption was reversed, duplicate_attempt indicates member tried to redeem same offer multiple times, expired indicates offer was past validity period, invalid indicates offer code was not recognized, pending indicates redemption is awaiting validation.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the offer was redeemed by the member at the restaurant unit. Represents the business event time of the redemption transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: External transaction reference number from the POS or OLO system. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this redemption record was last modified in the data platform. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: validation_method
attributes.description: Method used to validate and apply the offer at redemption. Barcode_scan for scanning printed or digital barcodes, manual_entry for cashier-entered codes, qr_code for QR code scanning, nfc_tap for near-field communication, api_validation for system-to-system validation, loyalty_card_swipe for physical card swipe.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the redemption was voided. Null if redemption was not voided.

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption was voided. Null if redemption was not voided.

products.name: challenge
products.description: Master record for gamification challenges within the loyalty program — visit streaks, spend milestones, menu exploration challenges, and social engagement tasks. Captures challenge name, challenge type (visit_streak, spend_milestone, item_discovery, referral, social), target criteria (e.g., visit 5 times in 30 days), reward upon completion (points, free item, tier bonus), eligibility scope (all members, specific tier, specific segment), start/end dates, and challenge status. Drives member engagement and frequency lift.

attributes.name: challenge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program challenge. Primary key.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Connects challenges to the franchisee that creates them, enabling franchise‑level challenge participation tracking and budgeting.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: add column program_id (BIGINT) with FK to loyalty.program.program_id - challenges must belong to a specific loyalty program

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the manager or director who approved this challenge for activation. Required for governance and compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this challenge was approved for launch. Null if still in draft status awaiting approval.

attributes.name: budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total marketing budget allocated for this challenge in dollars, including reward costs and promotional expenses. Used for Return on Investment (ROI) and Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) impact analysis.

attributes.name: challenge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the challenge: draft (being configured), active (live and available to members), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (ended successfully), cancelled (terminated early).

attributes.name: challenge_type
attributes.description: Category of gamification challenge: visit_streak (consecutive visits), spend_milestone (cumulative spend target), item_discovery (try new menu items), referral (invite friends), social_engagement (social media interaction), daypart_challenge (visit during specific daypart).

attributes.name: channel_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channels where challenge progress can be earned: POS (in-store Point of Sale), OLO (Online Ordering), DT (Drive-Thru), 3PD (Third-Party Delivery). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: POS|OLO|DT|3PD|KIOSK|MOBILE_APP|CATERING — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: challenge_code
attributes.description: Internal system code for the challenge used for tracking and integration across Point of Sale (POS) and Online Ordering (OLO) channels.

attributes.name: completion_count
attributes.description: Total number of members who have successfully completed this challenge. Used for performance analytics and Return on Investment (ROI) measurement.

attributes.name: completion_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days members have to complete the challenge from their enrollment or start date. Defines the time constraint for achievement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this challenge record was first created in the loyalty system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_participants
attributes.description: Current number of loyalty members enrolled in this challenge. Updated in real-time as members join. Used to enforce max_participants cap.

attributes.name: challenge_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the challenge rules, objectives, and how members can participate. Displayed in loyalty app and Online Ordering (OLO) platform.

attributes.name: eligibility_scope
attributes.description: Defines which loyalty members can participate: all_members (open to everyone), tier_specific (restricted to certain membership tiers), segment_specific (targeted customer segments), invite_only (by invitation).

attributes.name: eligible_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment code eligible for this challenge when eligibility_scope is segment_specific (e.g., 'HIGH_FREQUENCY', 'LAPSED_GUEST'). Null if not segment-restricted.

attributes.name: eligible_tier
attributes.description: Specific membership tier(s) eligible for this challenge when eligibility_scope is tier_specific (e.g., 'Gold', 'Platinum'). Null if open to all tiers.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the challenge expires and is no longer available for new enrollments or progress tracking. Existing participants may have additional time to complete based on completion_window_days.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_per_completion
attributes.description: Projected cost in dollars to the business for each member who completes the challenge, including reward value and operational costs. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and profitability modeling.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL to the promotional image or badge graphic for this challenge. Displayed in loyalty app, Online Ordering (OLO) platform, and marketing communications.

attributes.name: is_repeatable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a member can complete this challenge multiple times (True) or only once (False). Drives repeat engagement behavior.

attributes.name: max_participants
attributes.description: Maximum number of loyalty members who can enroll in this challenge. Null indicates unlimited participation. Used for limited-availability or exclusive challenges.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this challenge configuration. Used for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this challenge record was last updated. Tracks the most recent configuration change for audit and version control.

attributes.name: challenge_name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the gamification challenge displayed to loyalty members (e.g., 'Weekend Warrior', '5-Day Streak', 'Menu Explorer').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form internal notes for the marketing and loyalty operations teams. May include campaign context, learnings from previous iterations, or operational reminders.

attributes.name: priority_rank

attributes.name: target_acv_lift

attributes.name: target_quantity

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: challenge_enrollment

attributes.name: challenge_enrollment_id

attributes.name: campaign_id

attributes.name: challenge_restaurant_unit_id

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id

attributes.name: cancellation_date

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: completion_date

attributes.name: disqualification_reason

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: enrollment_channel

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member enrolled in the challenge.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the challenge enrollment, formatted as CE- followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Source or trigger that led to the enrollment (organic member action, promotional offer, referral, auto-enrollment, gamification, targeted campaign).

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the member enrolled in the challenge, including time zone information.

attributes.name: last_activity_date

attributes.name: last_activity_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: notification_enabled_flag

attributes.name: progress_percentage

attributes.name: reward_issued_date

attributes.name: reward_issued_flag

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: Type of reward earned upon challenge completion (points, discount, free item, bonus multiplier, tier upgrade, badge).

attributes.name: reward_value

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the challenge period begins for this enrollment.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target value required to complete the challenge (e.g., 10 visits, 500 points, 5 transactions).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last updated in the system.

products.name: program
products.description: Master configuration record for each loyalty program operated by Restaurants — covering program name, program type (points-based, visit-based, hybrid, subscription), currency name (e.g., 'Stars', 'Points', 'Coins'), points-to-dollar conversion rate, program launch date, geographic scope (global, regional, country), applicable restaurant formats (QSR, casual, fine-dining), enrollment channels, and program status. Supports multi-program architectures across franchise and company-owned units.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program. Primary key.

attributes.name: birthday_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus points awarded to members on their birthday. Zero if no birthday bonus is offered.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the loyalty program used in integrations and reporting (e.g., REWARDS_PLUS, STAR_CLUB).

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the program is available (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX). Null for global programs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Name of the loyalty currency used in the program (e.g., Stars, Points, Coins, Miles, Rewards).

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the loyalty program value proposition, benefits, and how it works. Used for internal reference and guest communications.

attributes.name: dollar_per_point
attributes.description: Monetary value of each loyalty point when redeemed. Used to calculate redemption value and liability.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program was discontinued or sunset. Null for active programs.

attributes.name: enrollment_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus points awarded to new members upon successful enrollment. Zero if no enrollment bonus is offered.

attributes.name: enrollment_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channels through which guests can enroll in the program (e.g., mobile_app, website, pos, kiosk, third_party).

attributes.name: gamification_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program includes gamification elements such as challenges, badges, streaks, or missions.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage of the loyalty program: global (all markets), regional (multi-country region), country (single country), state (sub-national), or local (specific metro/franchise group).

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program was officially launched and became available for guest enrollment.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the program manager for internal contact and escalation purposes.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the business owner or manager responsible for the loyalty program strategy and performance.

attributes.name: minimum_redemption_points
attributes.description: Minimum number of points required to make a redemption. Used to prevent micro-redemptions and manage transaction costs.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the program record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the loyalty program displayed to guests (e.g., Rewards Plus, Star Club, VIP Circle).

attributes.name: olo_integration_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program is integrated with online ordering platforms for digital points accrual and redemption.

attributes.name: ownership_model
attributes.description: Ownership structure of the loyalty program: corporate (company-owned only), franchise (franchise-owned only), or hybrid (both corporate and franchise participation).

attributes.name: personalization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program uses guest data to deliver personalized offers, recommendations, and communications.

attributes.name: points_expiration_months
attributes.description: Number of months after which unused loyalty points expire. Null if points never expire.

attributes.name: points_per_dollar
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points earned per dollar spent. Used to calculate points accrual from transaction amounts.

attributes.name: pos_integration_enabled_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the program is integrated with POS systems for in-store points accrual and redemption.

attributes.name: privacy_policy_url
attributes.description: Web URL to the privacy policy explaining how member data is collected, used, and protected.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the loyalty program: active (accepting enrollments and transactions), inactive (not operational), suspended (temporarily paused), pilot (testing phase), or sunset (being phased out).

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty program structure: points-based (earn and redeem points), visit-based (frequency rewards), hybrid (combination), subscription (paid membership), or tiered (status levels).

attributes.name: referral_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus points awarded to members who successfully refer a new member. Zero if no referral program exists.

attributes.name: restaurant_formats
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of restaurant formats where the program is valid (e.g., QSR, casual_dining, fine_dining, food_truck, ghost_kitchen).

attributes.name: subscription_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monthly or annual subscription fee required for paid membership programs. Null for free programs.

attributes.name: subscription_fee_frequency
attributes.description: Billing frequency for subscription-based programs: monthly, annual, or one-time. Null for free programs.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the primary guest segment the program is designed to attract and retain (e.g., frequent diners, families, business travelers, value seekers).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: Web URL to the official terms and conditions document governing the loyalty program.

attributes.name: third_party_delivery_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program supports points accrual and redemption through third-party delivery platforms.

attributes.name: tier_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program includes membership tiers with progressive benefits (True) or is a single-tier program (False).

products.name: enrollment_event

Captures member reference, program reference, enrollment channel (OLO, POS, in-app, kiosk, staff-assisted), enrollment restaurant unit, enrollment timestamp, referral source (organic, referral_code, campaign), welcome offer issued flag, and enrollment status. Feeds acquisition funnel analysis and channel attribution for the loyalty program.

attributes.name: enrollment_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program enrollment event. Primary key for the enrollment event transaction.

attributes.name: enrollment_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that drove the enrollment. Null if enrollment was not campaign-driven. Enables campaign ROI analysis.

attributes.name: enrollment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who assisted with the enrollment. Null for self-service enrollments. Used for staff performance tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_guest_order_id
attributes.description: Original transaction identifier from the source system. Used for reconciliation and traceability back to the source system.

attributes.name: enrollment_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where the enrollment occurred. Null for digital-only enrollments without a specific unit association.

attributes.name: initial_tier_id

attributes.name: primary_enrollment_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member who enrolled. Links to the member master record.

attributes.name: primary_enrollment_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where the enrollment occurred. Null for digital-only enrollments without a specific unit association.

attributes.name: primary_enrollment_staff_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who assisted with the enrollment. Null for self-service enrollments. Used for staff performance tracking.

attributes.name: primary_enrollment_transaction_guest_order_id
attributes.description: Original transaction identifier from the source system. Used for reconciliation and traceability back to the source system.

attributes.name: program_id

attributes.name: welcome_offer_id

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: email_opt_in_flag

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the enrollment occurred. OLO (Online Ordering) for web/app orders, POS (Point of Sale) for in-restaurant, mobile_app for native app, kiosk for self-service terminals, staff_assisted for employee-facilitated, web for website.

attributes.name: enrollment_country_code
attributes.description: Country where the enrollment occurred. ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country codes. Used for geographic segmentation and compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|FRA|DEU|AUS|JPN|CHN|BRA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to complete the enrollment. Supports channel and user experience analysis.

attributes.name: enrollment_geolocation
attributes.description: Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) of the enrollment location if captured. Format: latitude,longitude. Used for location-based analytics.

attributes.name: enrollment_ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the enrollment was initiated. Used for fraud detection and geographic analysis. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: enrollment_language
attributes.description: Language preference selected by the member at enrollment. ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes. Used for personalized communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eng|spa|fra|deu|ita|por|zho|jpn|kor — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_notes

attributes.name: enrollment_number

attributes.name: enrollment_source_system

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the enrollment event. Completed indicates successful enrollment; pending indicates awaiting verification; failed indicates enrollment did not complete; cancelled indicates member-initiated cancellation; reversed indicates system or compliance reversal.

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment event occurred in the source system. Represents the real-world business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment action. New indicates first-time enrollment; re_enrollment indicates returning member; transfer indicates program migration; upgrade indicates tier promotion enrollment.

attributes.name: fraud_check_status
attributes.description: Status of fraud detection checks performed at enrollment. Passed indicates clean enrollment; failed indicates suspected fraud; pending indicates checks in progress; not_required indicates no checks were performed.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numeric fraud risk score assigned to the enrollment event by fraud detection systems. Range typically 0-100, with higher scores indicating higher risk. Null if fraud checking was not performed.

attributes.name: initial_points_awarded
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points awarded to the member at enrollment as a sign-up bonus. Zero if no points were awarded.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member opted in to receive marketing communications at enrollment. True if opted in; False if declined.

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member opted in to receive mobile app push notifications at enrollment.

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Specific referral or campaign code used during enrollment. Enables attribution tracking for member-get-member programs and promotional campaigns.

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: Source that drove the enrollment. Organic for unprompted; referral_code for member referral; campaign for marketing campaign; social_media for social channels; email for email marketing; in_store for restaurant promotion; partner for third-party partner. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic|referral_code|campaign|social_media|email|in_store|partner — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sms_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member opted in to receive SMS/text message communications at enrollment. Required for TCPA compliance.

attributes.name: terms_accepted_flag

attributes.name: terms_version

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: verification_completed_flag

attributes.name: verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment requires additional verification (e.g., email verification, identity verification). True if verification is required; False if not required.

attributes.name: welcome_offer_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a welcome offer or sign-up bonus was issued to the member upon enrollment. True if issued; False if not issued.

products.name: referral
products.description: Tracks member-to-member referral events within the loyalty program. Captures referring member, referred guest (pre-enrollment), referral code used, referral channel (app share, email, social), referral date, referred member enrollment date (if converted), referral status (pending, converted, expired, fraudulent), and bonus points awarded to referrer upon successful conversion. Supports viral growth mechanics and referral program ROI measurement.

attributes.name: referral_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the referral event. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the marketing campaign or promotional period under which this referral was created. Supports campaign-level ROI analysis.

attributes.name: primary_referral_referred_member_id
attributes.description: Loyalty member ID assigned to the referred guest upon successful enrollment conversion. Null if referral has not yet converted.

attributes.name: referral_enrollment_location_unit_id
attributes.description: Restaurant location where the referred guest completed enrollment. Null for online enrollments. Supports location-level referral performance tracking.

attributes.name: referral_profile_id
attributes.description: Guest who received the referral invitation. May be pre-enrollment or post-enrollment guest identifier.

attributes.name: referral_referred_guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Guest who received the referral invitation. May be pre-enrollment or post-enrollment guest identifier.

attributes.name: referral_unit_id
attributes.description: Restaurant location where the referred guest completed enrollment. Null for online enrollments. Supports location-level referral performance tracking.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the referral invitation was shared. Supports attribution of viral growth mechanics across digital and physical touchpoints.

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code used by the referring member to track the referral. Generated by the loyalty platform and shared via referral channels.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date when the referred guest successfully enrolled in the loyalty program and the referral converted. Null if referral has not yet converted.

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the referred guest completed enrollment and the referral status changed to converted. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this referral record was first created in the loyalty system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the referral code expires and can no longer be used for enrollment. Supports time-bound referral campaigns and urgency mechanics.

attributes.name: first_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the referred member first purchase. Supports Average Check Value (ACV) lift analysis for referred members.

attributes.name: first_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the referred member first purchase transaction after enrollment. Used to measure referral quality and time-to-first-purchase.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this referral was flagged as fraudulent by automated or manual review. True if fraudulent activity detected.

attributes.name: fraud_reason
attributes.description: Description of the fraud detection reason if fraud_flag is true. Examples include duplicate device, self-referral, velocity abuse, or manual review findings.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this referral record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Optional personalized message included by the referring member when sharing the referral. Supports engagement analysis and sentiment tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified this referral record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the referring member initiated the referral event. Represents the business event timestamp for referral creation.

attributes.name: referral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the referral. Pending indicates awaiting conversion; converted indicates successful enrollment; expired indicates referral window closed; fraudulent indicates detected abuse; cancelled indicates referrer or system cancellation.

attributes.name: referral_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the referral was created in the loyalty system. Supports detailed event sequencing and time-of-day analysis.

attributes.name: referred_bonus_awarded_date
attributes.description: Date when the referred member bonus points were credited to the new member account. Null if bonus not yet awarded.

attributes.name: referred_bonus_points
attributes.description: Loyalty points awarded to the referred member upon successful enrollment. Incentivizes new member acquisition and first-transaction engagement.

attributes.name: referrer_bonus_awarded_date
attributes.description: Date when the referrer bonus points were credited to the referring member account. Null if bonus not yet awarded.

attributes.name: referrer_bonus_points
attributes.description: Loyalty points awarded to the referring member upon successful referral conversion. Supports referral program ROI measurement and member incentive tracking.

attributes.name: source_platform
attributes.description: Digital platform or system where the referral was initiated. Supports omnichannel referral attribution and platform performance analysis.

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version of the referral program terms and conditions accepted by the referring member at the time of referral creation. Supports compliance and audit trails.

products.name: loyalty_segment
products.description: Master record for loyalty member segments used for targeted offer distribution, personalized campaigns, and cohort analysis. Captures segment name, segment type (behavioral, demographic, tier-based, RFM, lifecycle), definition criteria (visit frequency, ACV ranges, daypart preferences, menu affinity), segment size, last refresh timestamp, refresh frequency, and active status. Also owns the member-segment assignment detail: each member assignment captures assignment date, removal date, assignment method (rule-based, manual, ML-model), segment version at assignment, and assignment source system. Managed by CRM/marketing team and consumed by offer distribution and campaign execution workflows. Supports temporal segment membership queries and before/after campaign cohort comparisons.
products.reference: Member Segment / CRM Segment / RFM Segment

attributes.name: loyalty_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the segment data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: loyalty_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the CRM or marketing team member responsible for managing this segment. Used for accountability, access control, and workflow routing.

attributes.name: owner_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the CRM or marketing team member responsible for managing this segment. Used for accountability, access control, and workflow routing.

attributes.name: trade_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.trade_area. Business justification: Segments are defined by trade‑area demographics; linking allows segment performance analysis by trade area.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the segment was first activated and made available for campaign use. Used for segment lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: acv_max_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum Average Check Value in USD for segment qualification. Used to define value-based cohorts and target budget-conscious guests with appropriate offers.

attributes.name: acv_min_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum Average Check Value in USD required for a member to qualify for this segment. Used to identify high-value guests for premium offers and personalized campaigns.

attributes.name: campaign_usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active marketing campaigns currently using this segment for offer distribution or personalized messaging. Used to assess segment utilization and prevent accidental deletion of in-use segments.

attributes.name: channel_preference
attributes.description: Primary ordering channel used by members in this segment. POS: in-store counter. OLO: online ordering (web/app). Drive-Thru: DT lane. 3PD: third-party delivery. Kiosk: self-service terminal. Used for channel-specific offer distribution.

attributes.name: control_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment serves as a control group (holdout) for campaign effectiveness measurement. True: control group, no offers sent. False: treatment group. Used for incrementality analysis and ROI measurement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the segment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and segment lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_tier_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty tier codes that qualify for this segment. Used for tier-based segmentation to target premium or entry-level members with tier-appropriate offers. Null if segment is not tier-specific.

attributes.name: daypart_preference
attributes.description: Primary daypart during which members in this segment typically visit. Used to target time-of-day specific offers and LTO promotions. Null if segment is not daypart-specific.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the segment was deactivated or archived. Null if segment is currently active. Used for segment lifecycle tracking and campaign history analysis.

attributes.name: definition_criteria
attributes.description: Structured or free-text representation of the business rules and thresholds used to assign members to this segment. Examples: visit_frequency >= 8 per month AND ACV >= $12; daypart = breakfast AND menu_category = coffee; tier = gold OR platinum; last_visit_days > 90.

attributes.name: exclusion_segment_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of segment IDs whose members should be excluded from this segment. Used for negative targeting and campaign suppression logic. Null if no exclusions apply.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage level of the segment. National: all locations. Regional: multi-state region. Market: DMA or metro area. Restaurant: single location. Used to control offer distribution and campaign reach.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the segment record was last updated. Includes changes to definition criteria, status, or metadata. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent segment membership refresh execution. Segment membership is recalculated periodically based on definition criteria. Used to monitor data freshness and refresh cadence.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_min

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Authoritative domain for general ledger (GL), accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), fixed assets (FA), cost center management, budgeting, P&L reporting, EBITDA tracking, CapEx/OpEx classification, revenue management, royalty income accounting, and multi-entity consolidation via SAP S/4HANA. GAAP/IFRS compliant financial statements.

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Chart of accounts master record for the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA (CO/GL modules). Defines every account code used across all legal entities, including P&L accounts, balance sheet accounts, cost element accounts, and statistical accounts. Supports multi-entity consolidation, GAAP/IFRS dual-ledger reporting, and account group hierarchies. Each record carries account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), functional area, account group, and currency settings.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost center master data and cost allocation activity from SAP S/4HANA CO module. Represents the smallest unit of cost accountability — individual restaurant units, regional offices, corporate departments, and shared service centers. Master data tracks cost center type (restaurant, regional, corporate), responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, valid-from/to dates, and hierarchy node. Allocation activity captures periodic distributions of shared costs (corporate overhead, IT, HR, marketing fund) using defined allocation keys (headcount, revenue, square footage), including sender/receiver relationships, allocation cycles, allocation rules, basis amounts, and reversal indicators. Enables fully-loaded restaurant P&L, Labor%/COGS%/OpEx allocation, accurate EBITDA by unit, and transparent overhead burden rates for franchise vs. company-owned comparisons.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entry from SAP S/4HANA FI-GL, encompassing both header and line-level detail. attributes.name: journal_last_modified_user_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this journal entry header (e.g., added notes, changed status). Blank if never modified after initial posting.

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system account that posted this journal entry. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 User Access Controls; SAP Security Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_period_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry was posted in a special adjustment period (periods 13-16) for year-end close. True if adjustment period; False if regular period.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the journal entry was approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if no approval required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: audit_class
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry for audit sampling and risk assessment. Values: standard (routine posting), high_risk (unusual or large amount), manual_adjustment (manual journal entry requiring scrutiny), system_generated (automated posting).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Risk Assessment; External Audit Standards

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: The baseline date from which payment terms are calculated (typically document date or posting date). Used to determine net due date and discount periods. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: Name of the batch input session if this journal entry was posted via batch processing (e.g., mass upload, automated interface). Blank for manually posted entries.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry was cleared. Populated only for cleared documents. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing document if this journal entry has been cleared (e.g., open item cleared by payment or offsetting entry). Blank if not cleared.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the legal entity within the SAP organizational structure. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; GAAP/IFRS Consolidation Requirements

attributes.name: consolidation_transaction_type
attributes.description: Three-character code classifying the journal entry for consolidation purposes (e.g., 100=standard posting, 200=intercompany elimination, 300=currency translation adjustment, 400=consolidation adjustment). Used in multi-entity financial consolidation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the document currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All line item amounts in this journal entry are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document (invoice date, receipt date, contract date). May differ from posting date. Used for aging analysis and payment terms calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo entered at the document header level. Provides business context for the journal entry (e.g., 'Monthly depreciation run', 'Accrual for Q4 marketing expenses').

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit accounting document number assigned by SAP upon posting. The externally-known unique identifier for this journal entry within the company code and fiscal year. Used for audit trail and cross-reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Management; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the nature of the accounting document (e.g., SA=GL account document, KR=vendor invoice, DR=customer invoice, AB=accounting document, AA=asset posting). Controls number ranges and posting keys.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the document was entered into the SAP system by the user. Used for audit trail and processing time analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert document currency to local currency at the time of posting. Expressed as local currency per one unit of document currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric posting period within the fiscal year (1-12 for regular periods, 13-16 for special/adjustment periods). Used for monthly P&L reporting and period-end close.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which the document is posted. Determines the accounting period structure and year-end closing scope.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany transactions between multiple legal entities within the corporate group. True if intercompany; False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time of the last modification to this journal entry header. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if never modified.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger in which this entry is posted (e.g., 0L=leading ledger for GAAP, 2L=IFRS ledger, 3L=management ledger). Supports parallel accounting for multiple reporting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA New GL; GAAP/IFRS Parallel Accounting

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code local currency. Used for statutory reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP/IFRS Functional Currency

attributes.name: net_due_date
attributes.description: The calculated due date for payment based on payment terms and baseline date. Used for cash flow forecasting and AP/AR aging. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: parked_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is in parked status (saved but not yet posted). True if parked; False if posted. Parked documents do not update GL balances until posted.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Four-character code defining payment terms for vendor invoices or customer invoices (e.g., net 30, 2/10 net 30). Used to calculate due dates and cash discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date for financial reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Posting Logic

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit numeric code that controls the type of posting (debit or credit) and the account type (e.g., 40=debit GL, 50=credit GL, 01=debit customer, 31=debit vendor). Determines field status and processing logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key Configuration

attributes.name: posting_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and real-time reporting.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Free-text field for external reference numbers such as vendor invoice number, purchase order number, or intercompany document reference. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a prior posting. True if this document reverses another document; False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Two-character code explaining why the document was reversed (e.g., 01=reversal in current period, 02=reversal in next period, 03=error correction). Populated only for reversal documents.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Maintains audit trail for accrual reversals and error corrections.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Reversal Logic; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system for this journal entry (e.g., SAP_ECC, SAP_S4, LEGACY_GL, COUPA, WORKDAY). Used for data lineage and interface reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date used for tax reporting purposes (may differ from posting date based on jurisdiction rules). Used for VAT/GST returns and sales tax filings. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Four-character company code of the intercompany trading partner. Populated only when intercompany_indicator is True. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Accounting; GAAP/IFRS Consolidation

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code (T-code) used to create this journal entry (e.g., FB01, FB50, F-02). Indicates the posting method and user interface path.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current state of the journal entry in the approval workflow. Values: draft (initial entry), pending_approval (submitted for review), approved (authorized but not posted), posted (final state in GL), rejected (not approved), cancelled (voided before posting).

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit/credit line items within a GL journal entry from SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Each line carries GL account, cost center, profit center, functional area, business area, amount in document and local currency, tax code, assignment field, and line item text. Enables granular P&L and balance sheet drill-down, cost center reporting, and intercompany reconciliation at the line level.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Journal Entry Line Item (FI-GL)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for granular GL transaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Line Item Schema

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Link line to cost_center master to normalize cost center details.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset master record if this line represents a fixed asset transaction (acquisition, depreciation, disposal). Null for non-FA entries.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Replace gl_account_code with authoritative FK to gl_account for detailed account attributes.

attributes.name: journal_customer_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer master record if this line represents an accounts receivable transaction. Null for non-AR entries.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header. Links this line to the overall accounting document.

attributes.name: journal_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record if this line represents an accounts payable transaction. Null for non-AP entries.

attributes.name: journal_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer master record if this line represents an accounts receivable transaction. Null for non-AR entries.

attributes.name: journal_vendor_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record if this line represents an accounts payable transaction. Null for non-AP entries.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Link line to profit_center master for consistent profit center data.

attributes.name: amount_document_currency
attributes.description: Transaction amount in the original document currency. Used for multi-currency transactions before conversion to local currency.

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: Transaction amount converted to the local reporting currency of the legal entity. Used for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text assignment field for additional reference information. Often used for invoice numbers, PO numbers, or internal tracking codes.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Calculation

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area for segment reporting. May represent franchise vs. company-owned, or QSR vs. casual dining divisions.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SAP S/4HANA Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this open item was cleared (paid or settled). Null if still open.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that settled this open item. Null if the line item is still open.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character company code representing the legal entity. Required for multi-entity consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration; GAAP Legal Entity Reporting

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) entry. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping.

attributes.name: document_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the document currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date of the source document (invoice date, receipt date). May differ from posting date for backdated or future-dated entries.
attributes.references: GAAP Source Document Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Document Date

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Payment due date for AP/AR line items. Calculated based on posting date and payment terms. Null for non-payable/receivable entries.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the journal entry was created in the system. Audit trail for data entry timing.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Currency exchange rate applied to convert document currency to local currency. Null if currencies are the same.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, or 1-13 for year-end adjustments.
attributes.references: GAAP Fiscal Period Standards; SAP S/4HANA Posting Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this line item is posted. Derived from the posting date and fiscal calendar configuration.
attributes.references: GAAP Fiscal Period Standards; SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting. Distinguishes COGS, labor, R&M, marketing, and administrative expenses.
attributes.references: GAAP Functional Expense Classification; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Functional Area

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text explaining the purpose or nature of this journal entry line. Provides business context for the transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Line Item Text

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry. Determines the order of debit and credit entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local reporting currency.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms code for AP/AR line items. Defines due date calculation and discount terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which this line item was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment.
attributes.references: GAAP Transaction Date Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Posting Date

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit posting key that controls the account type (GL, vendor, customer, asset) and debit/credit indicator. SAP-specific control field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Posting Key Configuration

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number (e.g., vendor invoice number, customer receipt number). Links GL entry to source transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a reversal entry. True if this line reverses a prior posting.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original entry that this line reverses. Null if not a reversal.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code for special GL transactions (e.g., down payments, guarantees, bills of exchange). Blank for standard postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Special GL Transactions

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item in local currency. Null if the line is non-taxable.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code applied to this line item. Determines sales tax, VAT, or GST treatment for revenue and expense transactions.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 334; Local Sales Tax Regulations; SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Trading partner code for intercompany transactions. Identifies the counterparty legal entity for consolidation and elimination entries.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Consolidation Standards; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Accounting

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code (T-code) used to create this entry (e.g., FB01, FB50, MIRO). Audit trail for process identification.

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this journal entry line. Audit trail for accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA User Master; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Value date for cash management and bank reconciliation. Represents the effective date funds are available or debited.

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable vendor invoice and payment lifecycle from SAP S/4HANA FI-AP, encompassing invoice header, line-level detail, and outbound payment settlement. Records all supplier invoices for food and beverage purchases, equipment, R&M, utilities, and services. Header stores vendor ID, invoice date, due date, payment terms, gross/net amount, tax, currency, payment block, three-way match status, and dunning level. Each line captures purchased item/service, quantity, unit price, GL account, cost center, PO reference, goods receipt reference, and tax code. Payment data stores payment method (ACH, wire, check), payment date, bank account, cleared invoice references, discount taken, and payment run ID. Enables COGS% analysis by ingredient category, food vs. non-food spend split, three-way match reconciliation, DPO (Days Payable Outstanding) tracking, cash discount optimization, and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts payable invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ap_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created the invoice record in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: ap_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the invoice for payment. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: ap_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified the invoice record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.

attributes.name: ap_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier or vendor who issued this invoice. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: ap_restaurant_location_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the restaurant location or unit to which this invoice expense is allocated. Used for unit-level P&L and Average Unit Volume (AUV) analysis.

attributes.name: ap_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the restaurant location or unit to which this invoice expense is allocated. Used for unit-level P&L and Average Unit Volume (AUV) analysis.

attributes.name: ap_vendor_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier or vendor who issued this invoice. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the invoice for payment. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Allows AP invoices for marketing media purchases to be tied to the originating campaign, supporting financial reconciliation and campaign ROI calculations.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was approved for payment. Used for tracking approval cycle time and compliance with payment policies.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the invoice approval workflow. Indicates whether the invoice has been reviewed and approved for payment by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character code representing the legal entity or company within the enterprise for which this invoice is recorded. Used for multi-entity consolidation and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the invoice expense is allocated. Used for departmental cost tracking and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts, volume discounts, or promotional allowances.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the vendor per the payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting and aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Baseline Date + Payment Terms

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The dunning level or escalation stage for overdue invoices. Zero indicates no dunning. Higher numbers indicate escalated collection efforts.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency invoice amounts to the company code local currency. Null for invoices in local currency.

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the invoice expense type. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) percentage and Operating Expense (OpEx) tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for monthly financial close and period-over-period analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice was posted, derived from the posting date. Used for annual financial reporting and year-over-year analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the invoice expense is posted. Used for P&L reporting and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number confirming physical receipt of goods or services. Used for three-way matching.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions, including line item charges and taxes. Represents the full amount billed by the vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. This is the principal business event timestamp for the invoice transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo field providing additional context about the invoice, such as the nature of goods or services purchased.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor-assigned invoice number as printed on the supplier invoice document. This is the externally-known business identifier for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type (standard invoice, credit memo for returns, debit memo for additional charges, prepayment, or recurring invoice).

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net invoice amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount payable to the vendor after applying discounts and adjustments. This is the amount that will be paid.

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating whether payment is blocked and the reason for the block (e.g., pricing dispute, quantity variance, quality issue). Empty if no block is active.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was actually paid to the vendor. Null if the invoice is unpaid.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used to pay the invoice (check, ACH, wire transfer, credit card, cash).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The payment document number or transaction reference assigned when the invoice was paid. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Determines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Used for period assignment and financial reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number against which this invoice is being verified. Used for three-way matching and spend tracking.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to a related document such as the original invoice for a credit memo, or a contract number. Provides audit trail and document linkage.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice, including sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process comparing purchase order (PO), goods receipt (GR), and invoice. Indicates whether the invoice matches the PO and GR within tolerance or has variances.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the invoice payment as required by tax regulations. Reduces the net payment to the vendor.

products.name: period_close
products.description: Financial period-end close activity tracking, consolidation output, and compliance evidence record for each legal entity and fiscal period from SAP S/4HANA FI. Captures close phase (pre-close, soft close, hard close), task completion status, responsible controller, accrual posting status, depreciation run status, intercompany reconciliation status, elimination journal status, consolidated trial balance sign-off, and final sign-off timestamp. products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Cost allocation and distribution records from SAP S/4HANA CO module. Captures periodic allocations of shared costs (corporate overhead, IT, HR, marketing fund) to restaurant cost centers and profit centers using defined allocation keys (headcount, revenue, square footage). Stores sender cost center, receiver cost center, allocation cycle, allocation rule, allocation basis, allocated amount, fiscal period, and reversal indicator. Enables fully-loaded restaurant P&L, accurate EBITDA by unit, and transparent overhead burden rates for franchise vs. company-owned comparisons.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_id
attributes.description: The specific allocation rule or assessment within the cycle that governs how costs are distributed. Defines sender-receiver relationships and allocation basis.

attributes.name: cost_employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person or system account that executed the allocation run.

attributes.name: cost_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the restaurant unit receiving the allocated cost. Enables unit-level EBITDA and fully-loaded P&L reporting.

attributes.name: cost_unit_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the restaurant unit receiving the allocated cost. Enables unit-level EBITDA and fully-loaded P&L reporting.

attributes.name: cost_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person or system account that executed the allocation run.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the franchise entity if the receiver is a franchised restaurant. Null for company-owned units. Used for franchise-level cost roll-up.

attributes.name: sender_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Replace cost allocation GL account code fields with FKs to gl_account for accurate allocation tracking.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount allocated from the sender cost center to the receiver cost center in this record. This is the product of total sender cost and allocation percentage.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_type

Common bases include headcount (FTE), revenue (AUV), square footage, transaction count (ADT), labor hours, fixed percentage, or custom formula. attributes.description: The quantity or weight of the allocation basis for the receiver. For example, if basis is headcount, this is the FTE count; if revenue, this is the AUV amount.

attributes.description: The batch or job identifier for the allocation run. All allocations executed in the same cycle run share the same batch ID for traceability.

attributes.name: allocation_cycle_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the allocation cycle or segment that defines the allocation rules and sequence. Examples: CORP_OH (corporate overhead), IT_ALLOC (IT cost allocation), MKT_FUND (marketing fund distribution).

attributes.name: allocation_description

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the sender cost center total that is allocated to this receiver. Calculated as receiver basis value divided by total basis value across all receivers. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0523 for 5.23%).

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Corporate bank account master record and daily transactional statement activity from SAP S/4HANA FI-TR (Treasury). Master data defines all operating, payroll, concentration, and zero-balance accounts across legal entities and geographies — storing bank name, account number (masked), IBAN/routing, account type, currency, cash pool group, signatory list, and reconciliation GL account. Statement lines capture daily electronic bank statement imports including value date, posting date, transaction type (credit/debit), amount, bank reference, counterparty name, clearing status, and matched GL posting. Supports daily automated bank reconciliation, real-time cash position reporting, fraud detection for restaurant cash deposits, POS settlement flow matching, and treasury cash pooling across entities.

products.name: lease_liability
products.description: Lease obligation and right-of-use (ROU) asset master record for ASC 842/IFRS 16 compliance from SAP S/4HANA RE-FX. products.name: site
products.description: Master record for every physical site under evaluation, active operation, or disposition in the restaurant real estate portfolio. Captures site identification, geographic coordinates, full address, market classification, trade area demographics, traffic counts (ADT), visibility scores, zoning classification, site type (pad, inline, endcap, freestanding, drive-thru capable), ownership status (owned/leased/ground-lease), parcel size, and current lifecycle stage (prospecting, under negotiation, LOI executed, active, temporarily closed, permanently closed, disposed). products.name: lease
products.description: Authoritative master record for every lease agreement governing a restaurant location, including ground leases, building leases, and sublease arrangements. Captures lease type, commencement and expiration dates, base rent, rent escalation schedule, renewal option terms, termination clauses, co-tenancy provisions, exclusive use rights, permitted use language, landlord entity, guarantor, and IFRS 16 / ASC 842 classification (operating vs. finance lease). Tracks right-of-use (ROU) asset value, lease liability, discount rate, and remaining lease term for accounting compliance. Includes structured clause abstractions: clause type (rent escalation, renewal option, termination right, co-tenancy, exclusivity, assignment, subletting, HVAC responsibility, CAM cap, audit right), clause text, effective date range, financial impact flag, and compliance obligation indicator. Links to site and landlord records. Serves as the SSOT for all lease agreement data including clause-level detail.
